Tea Party members lined up at the Old Cathedral of Communion for the Eden Peace Treaty The standard uniform of the Tea Party's officers consists of: White blouse with black cuffs, White gloves, High-waisted, black and white pleated skirt with gold trimmings buttons, White sailor collar with gold stripes, Black neckerchief, White caplet with gold trimmings, White beret with a golden trim around the base and a black ribbon at the back, White legwear and black loafers.
Members of Tea Party: Kirifuji Nagisa (Filius) Yurizono Seia (Sanctus), Misono Mika (Pater).

The Sisterhood is one of the School Clubs in Trinity General School. The Sisterhood is a major faction within Trinity whose influence is on par with that of the Tea Party and the Knight Hospitaller. They wish for the happiness and well-being of everyone in Kivotos, but many of Trinity's student are suspicious of them. Being the successors of the infamous Justina Council of Saints, they hold their fair share of secrets; some of which may shed light on Trinity's unknown history... A seemly large club within Trinity that depicts its members as nuns, their headquarters is notably the Trinity Cathedral where other students can visit or pray. Despite being geared towards worship and prayer, they possess immense influence within Trinity, and their intelligence network is said to be exceptional. Prior the school's formation, many individual factions fought against each other until the First Ecumenical Council took place, after which most of these factions formed an alliance that resulted in creation of Trinity General School. The Sisterhood was the successor to one of these factions—the Justina Council of Saints, and they were noted for their non-interventionalist policy towards the Tea Party in modern day Trinity. As the successors of the infamous Justina Council of Saints, the Sisterhood holds its fair share of secrets, and they're willing to use their capabilities to control the flow of information or even tampering it. In the Trinity Story Arc, the Sisterhood made their "full" appearance in the latter half of the chapter 2. They assist the members of the Supplementary Lesson Department and Sensei against Mika, who attempts to stage a coup with support from Arius. It is revealed that a "private talk" between Mari and Hanako earlier in the story might be a reason on why Sisterhood decided to "interrupt". This results in the Sisterhood renouncing their non-interventionist policy, later partaking as a witness to the signing of the Treaty of Eden. They appear again in chapter 4, alongside the Tea Party and the Knight Hospitaller, to discuss the aftermath of the attack during the Eden Treaty.
Members of Sisterhood: Utazumi Sakurako (Leader), Iochi Mari, Wakaba Hinata.

The Sisterhood is the only faction within Trinity that has their own firearm theme independent of Trinity. They exclusively use Israeli made weapons evident of their mass utilization of Galil rifles.

The Justice Realization Committee, also known as the Justice Task Force (JTF) in Global, is one of the School Clubs in Trinity General School. Their job is basically to enforce discipline within the school as well as deal with any troublemakers looking to disturb the peace. Even though Tsurugi is the official leader, it falls to Hasumi to actually carry out those duties due to Tsurugi's... problematic personality. The Justice Realization Committee acts as Trinity's disciplinary committee, similar to Gehenna's Prefect Team. Their main purpose is to uphold justice around the area of Trinity, hence the name. All of the JTF members have a red halo, black wings, a choker around the neck, and a black and red sailor uniform in common. In particular, the black uniform is exclusive to this committee, and it seems that the school doesn't have many spares in stock.
Members of JTF: Kenzaki Tsurugi (Сhairwoman), Hanekawa Hasumi (Vice Chairwoman) Shizuyama Mashiro, Nakamasa Ichika, Shimoe Koharu (Ex Member).

All known members of this club have the same primary color for their halos: red, although they have different shades of red.
Koharu was a former member of Justice Task Force, suffered from failing scores. The result is her having to join the Make-Up Work Club. However, even after passing the club's evaluation exam, she and her friends from the club decided to keep the club as a form of their friendship.

The Knights Hospitaller, or the Remedial Knights on Global, is one of the School Clubs in Trinity General School. Prior to the school's formation, the Knights Hospitaller were the center of a faction called the Johannes faction. Like the other pre-alliance factions, they fought against the other factions until the First Ecumenical Council, where it joined the Trinity alliance. As many of the clubs were succeeded by their descendants, such as with the Justina Council of Saints and the Sisterhood, or simply perhaps disbanded, the Knights Hospitaller eventually became the oldest club in Trinity. One of the clubs in Trinity whose members train to help other students with, in most cases, their general health. The appearance of its members is similar to a nurse (in training). They hold the record as Trinity's oldest club, having existed even during the pre-alliance days of the school. Unlike their Gehenna counterpart, the Emergency Medicine Club, the Knights Hospitaller have some authority in politics. However, much like the Emergency Medicine Club, their focus lies more on medical treatment, and is willing to defend and treat any just about patient, regardless of school or standing. In Volume 3, the captain of the Knights Hospitaller, Aomori Mine, took Seia into hiding following the assassination attempt on Seia and provided her with medical treatment. Later, during the events of the Eden Treaty Signing Incident, they provided medical assistance to injured students, alongside a critically wounded individual that was brought in by Sena of the Emergency Medicine Club. In Chapter 4, the Knights Hospitaller, alongside the Tea Party and the Sisterhood, gathered in a tea party to discuss the aftermath of the attack during the Eden Treaty Signing Incident. In Where All Miracles Begin, they, Sisterhood, Arius Squad, and Hanako went to attack Hieronymus in the catacombs. They are the main club in A Cathedral Christmas.
Members of Knights Hospitaller: Aomori Mine (Knight Captain), Sumi Serina, Asagao Hanae.

The Knights Hospitaller was the name of an actual, historical Catholic military order, more formally known as The Order of Knights of the Hospital of Saint John of Jerusalem. There are no overt references to Catholic mythology within the club other than the name, however.
The faction that leads the in-game Knights Hospitaller is the Johannes faction. Johannes is a medieval Latin name that typically appears as "John" in English language contexts. Both Johannes and John stem from the Greek name Ioannis, which in turn is a transliteration of the Hebrew name Yohanan.
Rather than an actual military order, the club could be more related to the St John Ambulance instead, an actual organization overseen by the Order of Saint John in providing first aid and emergency medical service, which matches the Knights Hospitaller's activities.
However, despite the naming, the in-game Knights Hospitallers do not use a Maltese cross like any real-world military or chivalric order, but rather a cross patoncé.

Library Committee is one of the School Clubs in Trinity General School. As suggested by their name, this club manages the library in Trinity. Shimiko is the librarian, while Ui works in the old section of the library, deciphering ancient texts. They first appeared in Sister and the Magician of the Old Bookstore. Sensei and Hinata went to the library to contact Ui in order to repair Sisterhood's ancient book. Ui agreed to repair the book, and ordered them to bring required materials. After the materials are brought, Ui repairs the book. Later, in Trinity's Extracurricular Activities, this matter become known by the Sisterhood and Ui is interrogated by Sakurako. Hanako mediates the interrogation and reached the conclusion that the incident would be ignored if Ui investigates the ruins in the island that the Sisterhood just discovered.
Members of Library Committee: Kozeki Ui (Head), Endo Shimiko.

After-School Sweets Club is one of the school clubs in Trinity General School. Similar to the Gourmet Research Society, the After-School Sweets Club serve as a food related club focused around sweets. Yoshimi leads the group, while Natsu is often the one, who provides extensive knowledge of sweets and personal philosophy. Airi and Kazusa endures her antics to look for the most delicious candy in all of Kivotos. The After School Sweets club makes their formal introduction in the Sister and the Magician of the Old Bookstore event. The story begins with Sensei running into the club waiting in line for the Miracle 5000 Cakes, which had been stolen by the thieves in a bid to scalp the cakes off to the highest bidder, according to Natsu. With Sensei's help, the club manage to defeat the scalpers and save the owner. And later, they help Sensei secretly deliver the book by creating a diversion by distributing the Miracle 5000 cakes for free. They are the main focus of the event A Tale of After-School Sweets. During this event, they have to deal with Kazusa's past, as well as Reisa. They are also the main focus of the event -ive aLIVE!. During this event, they formed the band "Sugar Rush".
Members of Sweets Club: Ibaragi Yoshimi (Head), Yutori Natsu, Kurimura Airi, Kyouyama Kazusa.

The club is often jokingly abbreviated by the community as the A.S.S. club.
Funnily enough, one form of the club's abbreviation in Korean (방디부) is done in such a way so that it roughly translates to the "bottom" club.
In a dev talk, one of the developers mentioned how he made the After-School Sweets Club and the scenario for their event. He thought of the club as group that represents the everyday side of things, such as things people would normally experience in school.

The Trinity Vigilante Club is one of the school clubs in Trinity General School. The currently known information of this club is it exist to maintain peace around the Trinity district, usually keeping the district clear from thug activities. According to Suzumi, the club is not an official club and anyone can volunteer to join the crew regardless of their background. While there's no clearly defined hierarchy of the club, Suzumi is considered the influential person in the club. Reisa also a popular person related to the club. Despite its status, Vigilante Crew is famously known for its independent and fierce image to the point some claims they would clash with Justice Realization Committee if they want to. The club does not seem to actively participated in Trinity politics, but has been involved in political incidents especially during the Eden Treaty chaos in Volume 3 when they stepped in to keep Trinity students off from fighting each other.
Members: Morizuki Suzumi, Uzawa Reisa.

The Supplementary Lessons Department, also known as the Make-Up Work Club on Global, is one of the school clubs in Trinity General School. The Supplementary Lesson Department is a club that was hastily formed by Trinity's student council, the Tea Party, to provide assistance to students with failing exam grades! Although this task would normally be handled by the Tea Party, the close proximity of the Eden Treaty means that they have little time to spare. The Make-Up Work club is a temporary club formed by the Tea Party to assist failing students. It is advised by Sensei and formed using SCHALE's authority. The club is designed to assist and deepen a student's understanding on their skills. It's a club that is only available for students who fail their exams, and will be dissolved once every member successfully passes an Evaluation Exam at once. While Sensei is in charge of helping the students, its members are encouraged to assist one another in their studies. In events, the members rarely appear together. Hifumi and Azusa are part of the main cast of Summer Sky's Wishlist, while Hanako and Koharu become part of the main cast of Trinity's Extracurricular Activities. All of them briefly met together at the end of the latter.
Members of Make-up club: Ajitani Hifumi (President) Shirasu Azusa, Shimoe Koharu (Ex JTF), Urawa Hanako.

Koharu was a former member of Justice Task Force, suffered from failing scores. The result is her having to join the Make-Up Work Club. However, even after passing the club's evaluation exam, she and her friends from the club decided to keep the club as a form of their friendship.
Azusa, an Arius Squad spy, became a double agent prior to the third make-up work exam in the first incarnation of the club, thus completing her transfer to the Trinity and Make-Up Work Club.

entries.name: Hyakkiyako
entries.content:
Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy or Allied Hyakkiyako Academy on Global, is one of the many schools in Kivotos.

Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy is a school of tourism, with gourmet food, hot springs, festivals and more! The academy is a coalition of clubs and committees, each with their own rules and regulations, so there is no formal student council. One of the schools in Kivotos, which unlike the others is simply more of a "coalition" of clubs of committees with their own respective rules and policies. Their main industry is tourism and is applied in a variety of activities, with the largest activities dubbed as "Festivals".

Due to the structure of Hyakkiyako, there is no formal student council in Hyakkiyako, though the Yin-Yang Club is sometimes seen as its de-facto student council.

Historically, Hyakkiyako was in a similar state to pre-alliance Trinity, where factions fought against one another in what was known as the age of the warring districts. According to a tale, the Great Prophet Kuzunoha established the Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council as a way to mediate conflicts between factions.

School Clubs: Yin-Yang Club (De Facto Student Council), Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council, Festival Management Committee (Festival Operations Department), Etiquette Training Society (Inner Discipline Club), Ninjutsu Research Department (Ninjutsu Research Club), Street Ghost Troupe (Street Mouryo), Nature's Beauty Club
Places: Hyakkiyako's Shopping District.

The Yin-Yang Club is one of the School Clubs in Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. The Yin-Yang Club is a club that exists to maintain balance at Hyakkiyako. Although Hyakkiyako does not have a formal student council, the Yin-Yang Club is often seen as the school's de-facto student council. However, it seems they're a bit famous, or perhaps infamous, for being bureaucratic when it comes to handling requests. The Yin-Yang club is one of the most important clubs in Hyakkiyako and is often seen as the school's de facto student council. As their name suggests, their purpose is to maintain balance at Hyakkiyako. When it comes to handling requests, the Yin-Yang Club is one of the two clubs to go to, but they're often uncooperative and bureaucratic. Most of the time, requests are turned down due to their supposed lack of authority, while accepted requests typically take extensive amounts of time to be processed, to the point where the requests have already been taken care of—for better or worse. Besides internal affairs, the Yin-Yang Club is also a key figure in Hyakkiyako's public relations and fiercely promotes the school to Kivotos.
Members of yin-yang club: Amachi Niya (President), Kuwakami Kaho (Vice-President), Waraku Chise.

The Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council is one of the clubs in Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. When it comes to conflicts at Hyakkiyako, there's two clubs the students turn to: the Yin-Yang Club and the Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council. Unlike the bureaucratic Yin-Yang Club, Hyakkaryouran has proven itself to be far more reliable in resolving matters, and a majority of cases are handled by the council. The club itself serves a similar role to the disciplinary clubs of other schools, but takes after its origins by primarily resolving conflicts through the mediation of both parties. Leadership in Hyakkaryouran is determined primarily by strength, with an old tradition that required the successor to defeat the leader in a battle for succession. Those who take on the position as the club's leader are recognized by the Great Prophet Kuzunoha as such and carry with them the "proof" of leadership, which comes in the form of an old rifle named the Hyakuren (百蓮) (lit. "Hundred Lotuses") that possesses the ability to suppress ghosts or, more specifically, ghost stories (怪談). According to a passage in a tale with broad and uncertain contents, the club was said to have been established by the Great Prophet Kuzunoha during the time of the warring districts as a means of mediating conflicts between the factions. Although the Great Prophet is treated as nothing more than an urban legend in modern Hyakkiyako, the presidents of the Hyakkaryouran claim to be able to communicate with her. Some time before Sensei's arrival in Kivotos, the club's chairwoman, Ayame, was taken into the Twilight (黄昏) by the president of the Nature's Beauty Club, Kokuriko, using the power of the One Hundred Ghost Stories (百物語) and disappeared. During the events of Cherry Blossom Festival, every member of Hyakkaryouran was inconveniently absent, leaving Shizuko to turn to the Yin-Yang Club for help instead. It's later revealed that the club is at risk of disbandment due to the disappearance of the club's president and vice-president, whose absence has caused the club to become dysfunctional and its members to lose morale—even to the point of considering quitting. In the Final Volume, the Ninjutsu Research Department is tasked with searching for the chair of the club, due to her ability to communicate with Kuzunoha. According to Niya's research, the place where the chairwoman would communicate with Kuzunoha is at the Twilight Temple (黄昏の寺院), located in Hyakkiyako's Great Snowfield. However, upon arrival, they coincidentally meet the vice-chair Nagusa, who communicates to them that the temple was destroyed long ago and its remains have long since been buried under the snow. While their request to meet the chair could not be accepted, due to their task by SCHALE, Nagusa hands over a scroll from the chair, Ayame. This scroll is later revealed to be a message from the Great Prophet herself. Other than Nagusa, no other Hyakkaryouran members were shown taking part in the events of the story, and it was later made known that they are ordered to not take part considering their current state. The state of Hyakkaryouran was only made clear in the Hyakka Ryōran volume, where a formal dissolution order was sent by Nagusa after her return. It was said that during the period when Nagusa and Ayame were absent, the members have been greatly reduced. Remaining members decided to move on after received the order, such as Renge participating in various clubs to "find her own youth". But as the news reached Yukari, she decided to take matters on her hands where she started her own succession challenge to Nagusa and other high ups in order to restore Hyakkaryouran. However as her bid to defeat Kikyou and Renge was crushed badly, Yukari gives up on reviving it. As events in Hyakkiyako Lantern Festival unfolds which put Hyakkiyako in terror and Yukari's life in danger, Kikyou, Renge and Nagusa reunited to keep the school out from Nature's Beauty Club and save Yukari whose life is threatened by Yabuki Shuro's deceiving of the situation. During their confrontation, Nagusa declared herself as the acting president of Hyakkaryouran and assumed her leadership mark of the club once again. After the events, Hyakkaryouran is back active, although their dissolution status is only put on-hold instead of cancelled due to their current state.
Members Hyakkaryouran Conflict: Goryou Nagusa (Acting President), Fuwa Renge (Captain), Kiryuu Kikyou (Strategist), Kadenokouji Yukari (Newcomer).

Hyakka-ryōran" is a Japanese phrase that literally means "hundred flowers blooming in profusion." The phrase has multiple meanings, with the closest to the literal definition meaning "a wide variety of flowers blooming." Other definitions include "a gathering of talented individuals", "the simultaneous emergence of many talents and achievements", and "a gathering of beautiful women (flowers)."
This club was referred to as Firebloom Conflict Resolution Council in the Japanese version of 2 Days Left screen of in-game 3rd Anniversary countdown,
They are the only organization in Kivotos that uses only one model of firearm for all of its members which is the Type 38 Arisaka Rifle.
With the exception of Kosaka Wakamo, the members of the Hyakkaryouran are also the only ones shown thus far in Hyakkiyako to use rifles.
Lotuses are often associated with purity, divinity, and the ability to overcome adversary.
As of June 2024, all playable members have Sonic attack with Heavy armor and good Urban compatibility.

Festival Management Committee or Festival Operations Department on Global, is one of the School Clubs in Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. They are responsible for managing and planning festivals and events involving Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. Shizuko and Pina also work at Momoyodou when there are no ongoing events. The group are basically the mastermind of all festivals in Hyakkiyako, and will put all their effort to make sure the students will participate in it. They are also interested on activities outside Hyakkiyako as well, including expanding Momoyodou's coverage like in Momoyodou Beach Bar Franchising Plan event. In Hyakka Ryōran volume, they are responsible on reviving the long-abandoned Lantern Festival, to the point of involving the Kadenokouji once again despite the family are the reason the festival was abandoned. While unfolding events resulted on the festival night abruptly canceled, they rehosted it later with some changes to their plan.
Members of Festival Management: Kawawa Shizuko (President), Asahina Pina, Satohama Umika.

Etiquette Training Society or Inner Discipline Club on Global, is one of the School Clubs in Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. Their main purpose is, like it's name is to train their inner discipline, although it has never been clear of what they do aim from that due to each member always behaved on their own when it comes to "training". However the club do participated actively in Hyakkiyako activities together and assisted other students with their volunteer works. They appeared as an assisting club in Cherry Blossom Festival and An Unconcealed Heart events, as well as Mimori appearing in Momoyodou Beach Bar Franchising Plan event on the club's behalf. In Hyakka Ryōran, they are involved in volunteer activities during Lantern Festival with Fuwa Renge joins them on a trial basis.
Members of Etiquette Training: Kasuga Tsubaki (President), Mizuha Mimori, Isami Kaede.

Ninjutsu Research Department or Ninjutsu Research Club on Global, is one of the School Clubs in Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. An unofficial club dedicated to studying the art of ninjutsu, located in Hyakkiyako's 38th Old School Building. This club is first mentioned in Cherry Blossom Festival as the club Izuna aspired to join. They are fully introduced during An Unconcealed Heart. In the event, they negotiated with Yin-Yang Club for their club's legitimacy. This is later complicated with kidnapping of Ibuki, which comes as Gehenna's representative during the festival. In Where All Miracles Begin, they are sent on a mission to the Snowy Mountains. They are attacked by enemies until a reinforcement from Pandemonium Society arrived. At Hyakka Ryōran, it is implied that this club is rumored to be Yin-Yang Club's secret agency. Later, they appeared to help Sensei and others that got caught in the attack of the festival. In Get Set, Go! Kivotos Halo Games, they appeared as contestants from Hyakkiyako. Outside of the game, they are the main cast of Michirucchi.
Members of Ninjutsu Research: Chidori Michiru (President), Kuda Izuna, Oono Tsukuyo.

The way its members learn ninja arts seems to be a nod towards McNinja, given how they seem to watch ninja movies and try to copy the moves rather than undergoing proper training.

The Street Ghost Troupe, or the Street Mouryo on Global, is one of the School Clubs at Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. A group who is responsible for disrupting festivals throughout Hyakkiyako district. They first appeared on the event Cherry Blossom Festival, in which Nyanten-maru hired them to disrupt the festival as Nyanten-maru was disappointed to see the festival use Millennium's holographic fireworks technology. They would appear again on An Unconcealed Heart, where they are hired by Amachi Niya to kidnap Ibuki during the show and threatened a diplomatic crisis between Hyakkiyako and Gehenna Academy as a result. Several members of the group were transported to the Millennium Ruins during A Certain Scientific Record of Youth. In Volume F, they participated in the defense of Hyakkiyako against Nameless Priests alongside Etiquette Training Society and Festival Management Committee. Some time later, in Hyakka Ryōran, they were intending to disrupt the festival as usual before they encountered Goryou Nagusa of Hyakkaryouran Conflict Resolution Council, who came back from the Great Snowfields. They are easily defeated by Nagusa, gaining their ire in the process. Soon after, they began the hunt against her, intending to take revenge. While they are searching for Nagusa, they found another members of Hyakkaryouran, Yukari and Renge. They attacked them both before retreating in front of Sensei. They finally found Nagusa in the night prior to festival and assaulted Nagusa with full force, forcing Sensei and Nagusa to hide. After the assault failed, they almost gave up at their attempt to defeat Nagusa and considered enjoying the festival at last when Yabuki Shuro of Nature's Beauty Club appeared before them, intending to "help" them with the power of One Hundred Ghost Stories. They accepted the request for help and at that moment, Nature's Beauty Club attack against the festival begins.
Members of Street Ghost: Arata (Leader).

For a long time, despite being a club who is local to Hyakkiyako, no known members besides generic mobs were introduced until Hyakka Ryōran.
This group's name is taken from Chimimōryō (魑魅魍魉), which is a Japanese term referring to demons or ghosts of mountains and rivers.

The Nature's Beauty Club is one of the School Clubs at Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy. A group that rejected the formation of the alliance that forms modern day Hyakkiyako. They are described as "the evil spirits of rivers and mountains that deceive people with their strange writings." To most in Hyakkiyako, they are nothing more than ghost stories; rumors and urban legends that spread throughout the academy. As Niya of the Yin-Yang Club puts it, they are One Hundred Ghost Stories (百物語). Their ultimate goal is to create their own "One Hundred Ghost Stories," which will set the world alight.
Members of The Nature's Beauty Club: Kokuriko (President), Yabuki Shuro.

Hyakumonogatari (百物語), often translated as One Hundred Ghost Stories after Katsushika Hokusai's famous work of the same name, is a reference to the Japanese parlor game Hyakumonogatari Kaidankai which was popular amongst samurai. In this game, 100 paper lanterns are lit indoors and participants take turns telling ghost stories called kaidan (怪談) (lit. strange talk). Every time a participant finishes telling a story, they would extinguish one of the lanterns. As the room progressively darkens, it's said that the room becomes more and more suitable for the evocation of a spirit/monster. Because it's rumored that extinguishing the 100th candle would evoke a spirit/monster, almost all records stop at the 99th lantern.
Kachoufuugetsu (花鳥風月部) a Japanese phrase that literally means "flowers, birds, wind, and moon." Due to the relations with beautiful aspects of nature, the phrase is used in reference to beautiful natural scenery, alongside any forms of art that seek to replicate that beauty.
The club's background and role is similar to Arius Branch School, as both are renegade sub-faction that opposed the formation of the alliance of their respective schools.

entries.name: Shanhaijing
entries.content:
Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School or Shanhaijing Secondary School on Global, is one of the many schools in Kivotos. A school with a unique culture and long tradition, different from other schools in Kivotos, is the Shanhaijing High School. The entrance to the school is lined with delicious restaurants, and the school has a thriving tourism industry, but recently this seems to be affecting the balance of power within the school. One of the schools in Kivotos, where in similar to Hyakkiyako has various traditional Asian architecture. Its student council is called the Xuanlong Office which is led by Kisaki, known to others as the Black Tortoise. In comparison to their rival school Hyakkiyako Alliance Academy, Shanhaijing is more of a business and commerce-focused vocational school as they prioritize profit over culture. Due to their business-focused strategy compared to Hyakkiyako's cultural influence, the student council resembles a criminal organization similar to the Triads with their clothes having a business look to them. Currently, there is a conflict between the student council and the Xuanwu Merchant Association for control over the school.

School Clubs: Xuanlong Office (Genryumon) (Student Council), Xuanwu Merchant Association (Black Tortoise Promenade), Chinese Alchemy Study Club (Eastern Alchemy Society), Training Support Department "Plum Blossom Garden".

The Xuanlong Office, or Genryumon on Global, is one of the School Clubs in Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School. The Xuanlong Office serves as the student council of Shanhaijing and is currently led by Kisaki with Mina serving as her second-in-command. The Xuanlong Office operates similar to a triad, not only managing the tourism business in Shanhaijing but also affairs outside of their school such as inspecting the Xuanwu Merchant Association's restaurant chains operations and forcing changes. In addition to that, the Genryumon also provides mercenary work and criminal services for business partners who can afford them as they make an appearance protecting the illicit interests of an auctioneer in the Warning of White Chalk event. They made their first appearance during Where All Miracles Begin, at the battle to protect Shanhaijing from the attack of The Iridescence's forces. They are one of the main clubs in Ryubu Doushu - What's Envisioned is One Sole Future. During the event, they have to deal with smuggling of Ten-Thousand-Year Ginseng while managing their relationship with Xuanwu Merchant Association. They established relationship with Red Winter Office during the Moonlight Dreams event, where they invited Red Winter Office to come to the school for an exchange trip.
Members of Xuanlong Office: Ryuuge Kisaki (President), Konoe Mina (Vice-President).

The Chinese Alchemy Study Club, or the Eastern Alchemy Society in Global, is one of the School Clubs in Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School. This club first appeared in Catch in Neverland. Saya developed a youth serum, which is then consumed by Shun, making her turn into a younger version of herself. This prompted Saya to make the antidote for it. They also appeared in Ryubu Doushu - What's Envisioned is One Sole Future. During the event, Kai and her relationship with the club is revealed.
Members of Chinese Alchemy study club: Shintani Kai (Former Head), Yakushi Saya.

The Training Support Department "Plum Blossom Garden" is one of the School Clubs in Shanhaijing Senior Secondary School. The Plum Blossom Garden is a club whose purpose is to teach students, especially kindergarten students. The club is named from a garden.
Members of training support department: Sunohara Shun, Sunohara Kokona.

entries.name: Red Winter
entries.content:
Red Winter Federal Academy is one of the many schools in Kivotos. Red Winter Federal Academy is a school located deep in the heart of Kivotos! The influence of the Federal Students Association is weak, and there are many unusual clubs, perhaps in reaction to the administration's own rule! The students are all unique! One of the schools in Kivotos having a large territory. Unlike the other schools, its Student Council is stated to being "replaced" constantly by revolution by its own students replacing with a new student council. Its current Student Council is under Cherino.

School Clubs: Red Winter Office (Student Council), Public Works Department (Labor Party), Knowledge Liberation Front, No. 227 Special Class (Spec Ops No. 227), Publishing Department.

Red Winter Office is the Student Council in Red Winter Federal Academy. As the student council of the Red Winter Academy, the Office holds a tremendous power and influence towards Red Winter students. In fact, everything in the Academy is subjected to its order, which is most of the time, is hold absolute by Cherino who mainly used her power in the Office to satisfy her personal tastes. Red Winter Office can also punish students at any time with whatever reason that can be considered an offence to the Office, which is also under the mercy of the President of the Office. There's no information if a leader can be selected properly to the office, but what's true is the President of the Office can be replaced through coups, which is quite common in the academy. In the Ivan Kupala the Revolution event, Marina assumed the Office leader for a while after a sudden coup, before being toppled the same way by Cherino. Red Winter Office has a close relationship with Pandemonium Society of Gehenna, as Pandemonium Society has visited the academy as a benchmark visit and met with Cherino during the visit. Some ideas by the Pandemonium Society is inspired on Cherino's doings in the academy. They also established relationship with Xuanlong Office in the Moonlight Dreams event.
Members of Red Winter Office: Renkawa Cherino (President), Sashiro Tomoe, Ikekura Marina.

Red Winter Office is the first student council that has its generic students implemented as in-game mobs.
With the release of Marina (Qipao) and Tomoe (Qipao), all members have a playable alternate variant.

The Public Works Department, or the Labor Party on Global, is one of School Clubs in Red Winter Federal Academy. The Public Works Department is a club that acts like a labor movement, whose members are part-time student employees. Most of their activities are protest marches for equal distribution of pudding and reducing working hours from 5 days a week to 3 days a week.
Members of The Public Works Department: Yasumori Minori (Leader)

The Knowledge Liberation Front is one of School Clubs in Red Winter Federal Academy. Knowledge Liberation Front is a club that maintains the Red Winter's library and advocates for freedom of knowledge within the academy through their vast archival activities. They are introduced during Ivan Kupala the Revolution. They are the main focus of Gakuman Doujin Monogatari. During the event, Meru and Momiji got into a fierce argument over a comic. Then, they have to reconcile while dealing with Publishing Department's demands.
Members of Knowledge Liberation Front: Himeki Meru, Akiizumi Momiji.

The No. 227 Special Class, or Spec Ops No. 227 on Global, is one of School Clubs in Red Winter Federal Academy. Unlike other schools in Kivotos, suspended students (those who violated certain laws) ended up in the No. 227 Special Class where they had to stay in a single dormitory. However, due to the negligence of the current head of the Red Winter Office, the students living in the dorms suffer from poor conditions.
Members of Spec Ops No. 227: Amami Nodoka, Mayoi Shigure.

Nodoka - Cause of suspension: Stalking students with a telescope.
Shigure - Cause of suspension: Adding alcohol on a drink (Kompot) during a festival.

The club's name refers to the Order No. 227 which was a historic military order during World War 2.
With the release of Shigure (Hot Spring), all members have an alternate playable variant (in this case, a Hot Spring one).

The Publishing Department is one of School Clubs in Red Winter Federal Academy. The Publishing Department is a club that manages the Red Bear, newspaper of the Red Winter Federal Academy, and is responsible for publishing works within the academy. This club made its first appearance at the event Gakuman Doujin Monogatari.
Members of Publishing Department: Aramaki Yakumo (President) Miyoshi Takane.

entries.name: Valkyrie Police
entries.content:
Valkyrie Police Academy or Valkyrie Police School on Global, also known as the Kivotos Student Police Department (KSPD), is one of the many schools in Kivotos. The Valkyrie Police Academy is a school that is responsible for maintaining public order and is involved in dealing with various problems in Kivotos. Unlike other schools that keep to only their districts, Valkyrie is actively engaged in all of Kivotos. As a result, there are bases all over Kivotos, and many of the students are filled with a sense of justice, but due to the restrictions of each municipality and other factors, the results seem to be almost rarely resolved by the Valkyrie alone... Valkyrie Police Academy is the primary municipal law enforcement agency of Kivotos. Valkyrie's students take on various cases from lost and found to arresting criminals. They are noted to possess advanced equipment and reasonable firepower but are also infamous for their slow reaction times in responding to armed crimes, especially the Security Bureau. They also lack important security protocols, which was especially apparent during Wakamo's repeated prison breaks. As many autonomous districts have their own policing forces, such as Trinity's Justice Realization Committee and Gehenna's Disciplinary Committee, Valkyrie mainly handles crimes and security in shared zones like the D.U. (District of Utnapishtim). Although they are able to operate in every autonomous district to an extent, but there are many restrictions in place that vary between each district that prevent them from mobilizing completely. Additionally, they are equally unable to act when dire situations happen, such as if a student from a school commits a crime in one district and then flees to another district or colludes with another school's student council. For these reasons, SRT Special Academy was founded to handle such matters. The school serves under the General Student Council's Defense Office.

School Clubs: Public Security Bureau (Public Peace Bureau), Security Bureau
Community Safety Bureau (Public Safety Bureau), Traffic Bureau (Public Safety Traffic).

The Public Security Bureau, or Public Peace Bureau on Global, is one of School Clubs in Valkyrie Police Academy. The Public Security Bureau is a bureau in Valkyrie that seems to work like a police tactical unit.
Members of Public Security Bureau: Ogata Kanna (Director), Konoka.

The Community Safety Bureau, or Public Safety Bureau on Global, is one of the School Clubs in Valkyrie Police Academy. The Community Safety Bureau is a bureau in Valkyrie that seems to work like a police patrol. Their main role is to assist and protect civilians. Civilian response work that falls under their responsibilities tends to be mundane day-to-day tasks, such as helping find lost items or pets, helping the elderly cross the road, and several others. Despite the relatively simple level of responsibility this bureau holds, not everyone can join.
Members of Community Safety Bureau: Nakatsukasa Kirino, Nemugaki Fubuki.

entries.name: Arius
entries.content:
Arius Branch School, or Arius Satellite School on Global, is one of the many schools in Kivotos. A faction that broke off from the Trinity Alliance and has been forgotten by time. It's said that no one—not even the General Student Council—knows where their autonomous district is, save for a few students attending Arius. Arius is a school that had broken off from Trinity General School. No one knows where their autonomous district is, except a few individuals such as Joumae Saori. The students of Arius primarily learn to fight and kill, rather than regular subjects that normal students would learn, making them a terrorist organization. Their motto is "Vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas." (Vanity of vanities and all is vanity.), which is based on Ecclesiastes 12:8: "Vanitas vanitatum, dixit Ecclesiastes; vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas." (Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.). Their logo is a skull with a crown and a rose, which are common elements of a vanitas artwork. It is later revealed that modern Arius' vendetta against Trinity was disciplined into the students by Beatrice, who was referred to as "Madame", via inhumane means such as torture and brainwashing as a method of controlling them. Beatrice resides over the school as its student council president, using Arius' Autonomous District as her base of operations. It is also through her powers that Arius' AD remains hidden to this day, as her powers allow for the path of entry into Arius, through Trinity's ancient catacombs, to change constantly. Prior to Beatrice's rule, the position of the student council president was hereditary, and the latest in line would have been Hakari Atsuko. It was also stated that Beatrice was also responsible for providing some of the deadly weapons Arius owned, such as the cruise missile, which was used during the Eden Treaty signing, and the halo-destroying bomb used by Azusa against the Arius Squad. Before the First Ecumenical Council, modern day Trinity was nothing more than a collection of hostile schools and factions. Eventually, through the efforts of the three major academies, the First Ecumenical Council was held, and a "promise" was made to stop the fighting between each school, forming the alliance that persists today. However, according to Misono Mika, Arius was fiercely against the formation of the alliance, and were later purged as a result. The Justina Council of Saints, despite being the most vocal faction to denounce Arius, led the school's exodus and took the lead with Arius' reconstruction. Approximately ten years prior to the start of the game, a civil war broke out in Arius that divided the school into two. It's unclear why the civil war broke out, but it was ended by Beatrice, who used the opportunity to take control of Arius as its student council president. She would use her power to manipulate the students by "teaching" them the "truth of the world." The students, who were oblivious to her intentions, believed her words as the truth. As such, allowing her to manifest their contempt towards Gehenna and Trinity to become the hatred they're known for nowadays. As the new president, Beatrice decided to turn Atsuko, who would have been the next president, into a sacrifice for what's known as the Iridescence with the intent to "ascend into a higher being."

At some point prior to the start of Volume 3, Mika approached the Arius Squad with an offer to make peace between them and Trinity, asking for an Arius student to be secretly transferred to Trinity to show that students from the two schools can get along. Saori reported this to Beatrice, who asked her to stall Mika and gain as much intelligence about Trinity from her as possible. Saori complied, but also asked Azusa to begin studying knowledge about Trinity in preparation for the mission, genuinely believing in the possibility for peace. However, the situation changed when Mika, annoyed at fellow Tea Party member Yurizono Seia, asked Arius to "teach her a lesson". Seeing this as an opportunity to remove a Tea Party member, the Arius Squad, at the order of Beatrice, dispatched Azusa to assassinate Seia using a halo-destroying bomb. However, Seia convinced Azusa to fake her death instead. With the help of Aomori Mine, Seia went into hiding. The Tea Party, unaware of Seia's survival, covered up her "death", with Kirifuji Nagisa succeeding her as the host. Following Seia's apparent death, Mika began panicking and hatched a plan to remove Nagisa in a coup d'état, place herself as the leader of Trinity and incorporate Arius as Trinity's new military arm, replacing the Justice Realization Committee. For her plan, she snuck a large Arius attack force into Trinity campus. Unbeknownst to her, Arius planned to turn on her following the success of the coup. Ultimately, Mika and the Arius attack force were defeated by the combined efforts of Sensei, the Supplementary Lesson Department, and the Sisterhood. Mika lost the will to fight upon hearing that Seia was still alive and was subsequently imprisoned.

Following the failed coup, Arius sought to sabotage the signing of the Eden Treaty. They approached Pandemonium Society President Hanuma Makoto, offering to help her wipe out the Tea Party at the signing ceremony. Because of this, Makoto, who was vehemently against Trinity, pretended to agree to the treaty. As a "token of friendship", they also gifted her an airship. Prior to the signing ceremony, Arius planted a large number of explosives underneath the site of the ceremony, the Old Cathedral of Communion. On the day of the signing, Arius launched a cruise missile at the Old Cathedral, detonating the explosives underneath and causing a massive explosion. Meanwhile, they also detonated the Pandemonium Society's airship, which was filled with crates of explosives. Taking advantage of the chaos, Arius Squad signed an altered version of the treaty, which stated that they, instead of Trinity and Gehenna, would serve as the Eden Treaty Organization (ETO). Meanwhile, using Atsuko's royal blood, Gematria member Maestro created a mimesis of the Justina Council of Saints, an immortal army dedicated to enforcing the treaty. The Arius Squad then designated both Trinity and Gehenna as violators of the treaty, causing the Council of Saints to attack both parties relentlessly.

School Club: Arius Squad.

The Arius Squad is one of the School Clubs in Arius Branch School. Before the name Arius Squad exists only a group formerly consisting of three students trying their best to survive the harsh environment that is the Arius Catacombs, which was under the hands of Beatrice, Arius' student council president. The students in question were Saori, Misaki, and Hiyori. It was thanks to their leader Saori that they were able to last. Originally, Atsuko was supposed to be made as a sacrifice under Beatrice's orders, but Saori made a deal with her, allowing Atsuko's fate to be postponed and giving Saori time to train her. Azusa, who is no longer a member now, was part of the group due to Saori rescuing her from being beaten up by guards for disobeying Beatrice's orders. Seeing the five students' capabilities which resulted from Saori's training, Beatrice saw a use for them, hence the beginning of the Arius Squad. An elite team formerly acting like a terrorist cell and consisting of five members formed by Beatrice yet only seen by her as mere pawns ready to be disposed of at any time. They are a Squad in command for the assassination attempt on Seia and the attack during the events of the Eden Treaty Signing. It was also during this time period that Azusa, who was originally assigned as a spy infiltrating Trinity, decided to become a double agent and betrayed the Squad after realizing the beauty of Trinity and the world, leaving a high-intensity conflict between Azusa and Arius' team and infuriating the Squad's leader, Saori. After their failed attempt in conquering both Gehenna and Trinity, Beatrice deemed them useless and decided to retrieve Atsuko back and initiate the ceremony to sacrifice her while leaving the other three members to perish, accidentally leading them to Sensei's hands.

The Arius Squad is currently out of favor at Trinity, Gehenna and Arius campuses. They are in exile. Due to Beatrice's teachings, all Arius Squad members are nihilistic. All members except Atsuko came from poor backgrounds.

Members of Arius Squad: Joumae Saori (Leader), Hakari Atsuko, Imashino Misaki, Tsuchinaga Hiyori.
Former Member: Now belonging to the Supplementary Lessons Department. Shirasu Azusa (Double Agent).

entries.name: SRT
entries.content:
SRT Special Academy was one of the many schools in Kivotos. The abbreviation SRT stands for "Special Response Team". An elite school that possessed authority from the General Student Council president to mobilize freely around Kivotos. However, following the GSC President's disappearance, the school was neglected and the decision to shut it down was made.

SRT Special Academy was originally an elite school, acting as the special forces command of Kivotos, and armed with the most advanced equipment in the city. Unlike Valkyrie Police Academy, SRT was given special authority by the GSC President, allowing them to mobilize anywhere, at any time, to respond to crime. However, following the disappearance of the GSC President, the school became unmanageable, after which a movement within the GSC began to shut down the school. The General Student Council eventually decided to shut down the school, with rumors spreading around the press that a previous commotion at the Sanctum Tower had something to do with the decision. This is later confirmed to be an incident during the closure movement, in which the FOX Platoon assaulted GSC members that supported the movement and even destroyed a portion of the Sanctum Tower in the process. This incident served as the final nail in the coffin, and the decision to merge SRT with Valkyrie was made. However, not all students were satisfied with the decision and refused to transfer, holding a public protest within Usagi Park. They continued to live there under Sensei's suggestion after being given the authority to decide SRT's fate by the chief of the GSC's Defense Office, Shiranui Kaya. Sensei also indirectly provides them food by letting them have Angel 24's disposed near-expiration bentos and provides them with other supplies using their credit card.
School Clubs: RABBIT Platoon, FOX Platoon.

While the official English translation of the game uses the word "squad" to describe the fireteams in SRT, both the JP and KR versions use the word "platoon". The usage of platoon is further supported by the presence of platoon position markings on the FOX Platoon's neckerchiefs.
It is not confirmed whether the platoons are missing its personnel that require to form full-strength platoons or they are organically organized as 4-man fireteams.
During the RABBIT Platoon's interrogation in V4C1E3, Miyako mentions how she's looked up to SRT ever since she was little, implying that SRT has existed for years. However, SRT only recently gained the attention of the public thanks to the breaking news surrounding the Fox Platoon when they were involved in a firefight at a factory. In the JP version of the game, this line was simplified to simply Miyako stating that she admired SRT, which mends the timing issue that the line creates.
SRT teams are modeled after real-world elite infantry units such as light infantry and special forces units.
In the RABBIT Platoon's case, they are modeled after the Finnish Utti Jaeger Regiment.
In the FOX Platoon's case, they are modeled after the United States' Tier One JSOC units such as SEAL Team Six and Delta Force.
This school uses Valkyrie's skill discs and books.
In the RABBIT Platoon and the Mystery of the Missing Shrimp event, it was revealed SRT had an official channel that had around 1.000 subscribers before the school's closure.

The RABBIT Platoon, also known as the RABBIT Squad in Global, is one of the School Clubs in SRT Special Academy. The RABBIT Platoon is a fireteam of four freshmen from the elite SRT Special Academy. They are excellent students but are just as affected by the closure and disbandment of SRT. Unlike the rest, they refuse to give up, and hold up in Kousagi Park (known as Bunny Park in Global) to protest the decision. A fireteam of four freshmen students. In protest of the closure of SRT, the RABBIT Platoon occupied Kousagi Park, where they staged a demonstration and repelled attempts by Valkyrie to detain them until Sensei's arrival. After their release, they returned to Kousagi Park and began "camping" there under Sensei's suggestions, living off of the park's free amenities and objects to be disposed, such as expired bento from Angel 24 and oil barrels. Eventually, the park became RABBIT Platoon's official home and base of operations. Unfortunately, not everyone was happy with their decision to make the park their home, especially Kaiser Construction, who planned to redevelop Kousagi Park and the buildings around it into Kousagi Town (known as Bunny Town in Global), which also included a subway station with a shopping center on top of it. Kaiser even went so far as to illegally work with Valkyrie in an attempt to vacate the area from vagabonds and the RABBIT Platoon. As the name implies, all four members of the RABBIT Platoon wear rabbit ear-like headgear and uses rabbit foods as their operation names, such as "Operation: Clover" or "Operation: Carrot." They are the main club of The Rabbit of Caerbannog. In Chapter 1, they are protesting against SRT's closure by doing a sit-in at Kousagi Park. Then, they have to improve their capabilities as a team while managing their relationship with Sensei. Later, they uncovered the secret dealing between Kaiser and Valkyrie in Operation Clover. In Where All Miracles Begin, due to their relative isolation, they did not know about the martial law imposed on D.U. Then, they met Sensei that just escaped. They, along with Valkyrie students, recaptured SCHALE in "Operation Recapture Schale". Later, they, along with Game Development Department and Hina, went to Slumpia to defeat Shiro and Kuro. In Chapter 2 of The Rabbit of Caerbannog, they are dealing with their relationship with FOX Platoon. During an attempted infiltration of a warehouse, they are captured by FOX Platoon. Then, they agreed to join with the premise of SRT's revival. Later, after learning about Kaya's plan to use the ANTIOCH thermobaric bomb and Yukino's willingness to go along with said plan, Miyako decided to oppose them. Then, they joined forces with Valkyrie and Descartes to defeat Kaiser troops guarding the place. They later went to the underground silo where the bomb is located and fought FOX Platoon there. After defeating FOX Platoon, they went to D.U. and overthrow Kaya. They are the main cast of RABBIT Platoon and the Mystery of the Missing Shrimp. They went to a fishing village to investigate the lack of shrimp export. They have to deal with the locals, which find their presence unpleasant. After that, they found out about "The Old Ones" myth and investigating it. Later, they found out that the myth is a cover for illegal operations of the shipping company. After that, they and the locals went to the ship to catch the company's official and restored delivery of shrimps. In Get Set, Go! Kivotos Halo Games, they are the contestants from SRT.
Members of Rabbit platoon: Tsukiyuki Miyako (Leader RABBIT 1), Sorai Saki (Pointwoman RABBIT 2), Kazekura Moe (Pilot RABBIT 3), Kasumizawa Miyu (Sniper RABBIT 4).

Despite living in the park, the RABBIT Platoon has a Sikorsky MH-60L Black Hawk utility helicopter as part of their arsenal. This implies they have access to a hangar, a landing pad, equipment to convert it into a DAP gunship, and a healthy supply of fuel and heavy ordinance somewhere. The team's pilot, Moe, can be regularly seen doing a bombing run with it as evident of her EX Skill. This aircraft is also the team's primary vehicle for quick insertion and extraction like in the near end of V4C1.
As such, the Black Hawk is often reconfigured depending on what role it is fulfilling like in Saki's EX Skill or Miyako's Memorial CG where it's used as a transport helicopter, or in Moe's EX skill where it is kitted with ESSS stub wings as a DAP configured Black Hawk.
The RABBIT Platoon is likely modeled after the Finnish Utti Jaeger Regiment.
This club is associated with the BGM Usagi Flap.
With the release of Moe (Swimsuit), all club members have a playable variant (in this case, a Swimsuit one).

The FOX Platoon, also known as the FOX Squad in Global, is one of the clubs in SRT Special Academy. The FOX Platoon was a well-achieved fireteam in SRT Special Academy but went AWOL after a certain incident. The FOX Platoon was a fireteam within SRT Special Academy, comprised of four third-year students. They are a well-accomplished fireteam, having even been responsible for detaining Wakamo before Sensei's arrival in Kivotos. However, following a movement by some within the General Student Council to shut down SRT, the FOX Platoon assaulted the GSC as retaliation and even destroyed parts of the Sanctum Tower. They are currently working with Kaya, who is also working with Kaiser to accomplish a coup d'etat in order to restore SRT and abolish SCHALE. As the name implies, all four members of the FOX Platoon have fox ears. Coincidentally, they're mostly known for apprehending Wakamo, the Fox of Calamity.
Members of FOX squad: Shichido Yukino (Leader), Niko (Sergeant), Kurumi (Pointwoman), Otogi (Sniper).

entries.name: Highlander
entries.content:
Highlander Railroad Academy is one of the many schools in Kivotos.

Highlander Railroad Academy is under the control of Saint Nephthys Company, a private company operating in Kivotos. In the words of Asagiri Suou, "We're one and the same at this point." when questioned about Nephthys Group buying the bonds related to the Trans-Desert Railroad in Abydos. Different regions and even individual railroad lines are under the control of different internal factions, which compete with each other, based off some sort of points system. It is known to individuals outside of Highlander, that the internal operations of the academy can become extremely political.

Structure: Central Control Center acts as the school's student council. In an unusual design, an organization oversees the student council, Highlander Supervision Office, which reports to and carries out the wishes of a board of directors, likely at Nephthys Group.

Highlander Railroad Academy is a corporate academy which focuses on operating railroad and trains in Kivotos. It can be said that most of the train services in Kivotos is under their control. They also excel in educating students about railroads and the like.

Unlike territorial-based schools which set their own governance on the certain district they are located, Highlander, being a service-focused school, practiced their jurisdictions in trains and railroad routes they do own, which sprawls through various districts. Additionally, the organizations within this school are all independent, but some are tasked to manage each other, such as the Highlander Supervision Office overseeing the Central Control Center.

In addition to railroad operations, the academy has other, unspecified, business ventures.

entries.name: School Club
entries.content: School Club are extracurricular activities that exist in all schools in Blue Archive. This article will list all clubs available. School Clubs are generally the main groups of students within Blue Archive. They represent a variety of different activities and interests, whether for important duties such as accounting or leading a school, or for simple gatherings of students with shared interests such as sweets and games. For ease of organization, each student will have their club listed in their profile alongside their school. When Sensei interacts with students as a group, it will usually be together with their clubs.

entries.name: Sensei
entries.content:
Sensei is the player's character and main protagonist of Blue Archive who serves as the advisor of SCHALE, and also an adult. A teacher called by the President of the General Student Council to save Kivotos from the initial criminal uprising. From there, supported by Arona and the students of various academies, Sensei watches over Kivotos, solving problems, protecting the people, and getting into all sorts of (mis)adventures and wacky antics all the while.

A teacher with a strange affinity for military tactics, Sensei is the advisor for SCHALE. With the help of Arona and the students of various academies, Sensei keeps the peace in Kivotos while getting into wacky antics with the city's students, guiding them to be better while getting closer to them.

Sensei's personality varies wildly, be it childish or mature, oblivious or sharp, cunning or gullible. In general, Sensei seem to change their attitude to fit the students. Sensei has an unusual obsession with gacha games, robots and other childish obsessions, while also giving nuggets of wisdom and being able to teach and encourage students. These changes only vary more with player dialogue choices. The only constants in personality are their dedication to safeguarding the wellbeing and happiness of their students, and their unusual affinity for combat tactics. Together, these allow Sensei to become a magnetic personality that attracts the students to them, with many of the girls even developing romantic feelings. In-game, Sensei is the player's self-insert character, allowing the player to imagine their sex or any appearance they want for themselves. Though Isakusan, the scenario director, specifies that Sensei is supposed to represent how the player wants to represent themselves as, there is one notable instance of a "canon" appearance for Sensei: Arona once depicted Sensei as a crude, childishly drawn smiling character on Arona Channel, a depiction that became popular throughout the fandom. Arona would reuse this depiction of Sensei when she baked cookies showing her and Sensei together holding hands; in that respect, we can say it is the only icon appeared in-game. Publishers seem to be using it conveniently, such as the SRT mini-game released for limited time, the TW-official hot dog shop collaboration, and graffiti on the JP-official images. Isakusan also defines all media franchises of Sensei as non-canon for the original game. As such, other platforms can depict Sensei freely. The infamous Problem Solver 68 Manga where Sensei is depicted as a handsome young man with short hair, wearing glasses, a black undershirt and a long white professor's coat. In the Game Development Department's Manga, Sensei has a head similar to a portrait by Arona and a tremendous mass of muscles. In other manga anthologies also have many variations of Sensei's gender, age, and appearance widely. In the 2024 anime adaptation, Sensei's appearance uses clothing that is common among adults working as white-collar office workers, with Sensei wearing a gray suit with matching pants, and a white long-sleeved polo shirt worn underneath, black tie, and black shoes. Similarly, the facial expressions are reminiscent of the greatest common denominator faces that are often used in illustrations of government offices and public spaces in East Asia.

The "Adult Card", also known as the "Credit Card" on Global, is Sensei's trump card. According to Maestro, it is a power obtained for the price of life and time, and is very alien that even the eldritch beings of Gematria require "meta-cognition" to comprehend it. Although the exact capability of the Adult Card is still unknown, it allows Sensei to fight on a level even beyond the superhuman students of Kivotos. This is depicted in gameplay by allowing you to use your own student lineup in a story episode battle instead of a pre-arranged story team. The card itself is a meta reference to gacha mechanics, especially for longtime, paying players. This type of players has likely built up a roster of powerful students by paying for gacha rolls and stamina refreshes to create a strong team, spending time and money and using a credit card to make the payment. Black Suit also mentioned that continuous abuse of the card can lead to a sort of corruption similar to what Gematria has gone through. Though what this actually means is still unclear, it can be said that this is a reference to people who abuse their Credit Cards too much and end up broke. The Credit Card has been used five times in the story so far: once to defeat an incomplete version of Hieronymus during V3C3E24, the second time to rescue Mika during V3C4E25, the third to clear out mysterious enemies surrounding the District of Utnapishtim during VFC2E1, the fourth to battle Phrenapates during VFC4E6, and the fifth to defeat The Fury of Set during V1C3E39. Though not confirmed, according to the teaser images, Sensei would be seen armed with a Beretta 92FS handgun, sporting the SCHALE insignia stamped on the grips. The pistol is likely for self defense purposes although it is never used.

Genius Intellect: As a teacher, Sensei is likely smarter than most characters in the game when it comes to certain aspects such as military tactics and serious topics like politics, things that most students would probably not understand as much unless they focus on those topics, and can easily teach multiple students. They are also able to provide various moral lessons that fit with the situation, such as the infamous quote: "If you believe that your bikini bottoms are panties, then they're panties.", which they said to Yurizono Seia. The quote itself means that "If you believe that something is right or important, so it is."
Military Acumen: Sensei doesn't directly engage in combat. However, they somehow possess military strategies and tactics, and are the one directing the students in combat, specifically shown by the player choosing who to deploy in combat, where they move in missions and when and where to activate the students' EX Skills. Sensei's knowledge in tactics and commanding capabilities has allowed them to turn the tides in various disadvantageous battles.
SCHALE Rights: Sensei has extrajudicial authority under SCHALE, being able to perform certain duties and bypass procedures for the sake of the students. This allows enlistment of any student from any school to take part in missions, being able to act as club advisor, allowing immediate establishment of a club in a matter of hours and even standing in for the General Student Council President in absolute emergencies, as seen in V3C3E19.
"Authority": Sensei seems to have a supernatural authority within Kivotos. Aside from the extrajudicial authority provided by SCHALE, certain areas and objects require Sensei to open, such as the Shittim Chest and the Ruins during the Millennium Arc.

Vulnerability to Bodily Harm: As a normal person, unlike the incredibly durable citizens of Kivotos, Sensei is significantly vulnerable to bullets, as they can potentially die in one shot. A fitting example is during the Treaty of Eden (Volume 3), where Sensei once got shot by Saori and, despite Hina taking the bullet to protect Sensei, the bullet fragments caused serious injuries leading them to lose consciousness. This weakness is covered by the Shittim Chest's ability to protect them should it be in close proximity and have enough power. Outside such cases, Sensei is vulnerable to harm. The protection it grants is also limited, as it cannot protect them from grave threats nor when the power runs out.
Acrophobia (fear of heights): During the Rabbit of Caerbannog Arc, Sensei was part of Operation: Clover, an operation where the members of the RABBIT Platoon would infiltrate Valkyrie to retrieve evidence of Valkyrie's illegal activities with the Kaiser Corporation. During the infiltration, the Rabbit Platoon members grappled down from a building, but Sensei didn't follow along with them. One of the dialogue options during this situation mentioned that Sensei has a fear of heights. Additionally, in Kotama's Relationship Stories Episode 1: Grown-Up Secrets, she tried to wiretap Schale's Executive Office but was caught by Sensei. Somewhere along the conversation, Sensei admitted that their weakness was being afraid of heights.

Although Sensei is never directly addressed as a male, there are a number of indirect references that suggest that Sensei is male, as in the following quote from Saki when replying to Sensei's suggestion for her to do a handstand, "Why would you ask a female student wearing a skirt to do a handstand?" However, in Akane's student story, teachers can specify to be called an 'onii-chan' or 'onee-chan', the latter being the female equivalent of big brother in Japanese.
Regarding pronouns, Sensei is referred to as "they", adding to the ambiguity.
Despite the fact that Sensei's gender is purposely kept ambiguous in-game, the global version of the game often uses language that directly asserts Sensei as male.
In the JP version, the situation is a little bit different. As a linguistic property of Japanese tones change blatantly depending on gender, but Sensei's aren't. Their first person pronoun is "watashi" (私), gender independent words that are used by both genders in formal settings, but have a neutral or slightly feminine impression in private spaces. Gender-specific tones are also avoided. This localization policy blurs gender even more than he/she's intentional avoidance.
Sensei's face isn't officially shown in game, but Arona has made a drawing of their face as well as a gingerbread chocolate figure of them. At the very least, they are not bald.
Arona's Sensei drawing is also frequently used by the community.
As Volume 3 reveals, education in Kivotos is mostly done by Blu-Ray, with in-person teaching being restricted to guest lecturers and assistants. Thus, Sensei is possibly the only traditional dedicated teacher in the entirety of Kivotos.
In fact, Koyuki was surprised to meet a teacher for the first time when she met Sensei during the Bunny Chaser on Board event.
In an interview with the scenario writer, Isakusan, it's revealed that a "teacher" is a being that has completed their growth, or a complete being. What this fully entails is still unknown, but this contrasts Sensei with their "incomplete" students.
Sensei's appearance in the Blue Archive Problem Solver 68 Business Diary manga has led some of the English-speaking fans to point out his loose resemblance to Sōsuke Aizen, a character from a manga titled "Bleach".
Sensei's official appearance on "Blue Archive, The Animation", along with the key visual reveals prior to the premiere, has caused a sudden viral trend throughout most social medias as their gender is always an unanswered question, and their iconic "doodle" version is the only official one in the original game. This Sensei was also designed by DoReMi, who was thankful for being chosen for the project. This makes DoReMi the official artist for Sensei of the Animation.
Although most official depictions of Sensei are not visibly armed, they would likely be owning a Beretta 92FS pistol as shown on the teaser image. This is likely their SCHALE issued firearm given the insignia stamped on the grips likely for self defense purposes. Despite that, they would not be seen carrying it around when near students.
This could also be for Sensei's sake since they would be less likely to be pointed at with a gun in case a firefight erupts. This is because armed women would often prioritize other armed assailants in a gunfight. And given Sensei's extreme vulnerability against conventional firearms, this is the likely reason why they are not seen carrying around a gun.
Fanfiction stories (and to an extent, the officially-publlished Anthologies) usually don't use the "official" version of Sensei, as the role is usually held by either an original creation of the fanfiction's writer (in stories that exclusively center on Blue Archive) or a character from another media series (in stories of the crossover variety).

entries.name: Arona
entries.content:
Arona is a non-playable character in Blue Archive that resides in the mysterious Shittim Chest. She accompanies Sensei throughout their adventure in Kivotos as a guide. She is the main mascot of Blue Archive, appearing as the figurehead on its website and social media. In addition to providing information and updates to Sensei, she also runs a series of videos called Arona Channel.

Arona is a self-proclaimed high-performance AI who serves as the OS of the Shittim Chest. She resides in a desolate classroom located in the midst of a watery expanse, stretching further than the eye can see. When she's not helping Sensei with their tasks, she's up to goofy antics that appear on Arona Channel. Arona has a child-like personality and is quite gullible, often falling for Sensei's jokes. Arona thoroughly enjoys sweets, being quick to abandon a diet for the sake of sweets—or even breaking into tears from being denied them. Arona is a small AI girl with short sky blue/violet hair with bangs covering her left eye, a white headband with a large bow, and braids tied to her left side. She has bright blue eyes and has heterochromia, with the right eye having a blue pupil and the left having a violet pupil. Arona's halo is interchangeable based on her emotions. She resembles the president of the general student council. Arona normal halo is a simple blue ring that resembles a stock power button LED ring sometimes found on certain desktop computers, but it changes to different colors and shapes based on her mood: Default Blue Circle, Sad Dark Blue Drip, Happy Pink Hearts, Motivated Green Stars, Shocked Light Blue Spikes, Light Blue Spikes, Angered Orange Spikes. She's wear sailor uniform is tied in a ribbon with long sleeves; has a white collar, and white ribbon ties with an LED ring stuck in one of them. The choker and white sneakers have bow-like shoelaces. Her white skirt has ○×+△ symbol on it. As a powerful AI, Arona originally had authority over many functions in Kivotos, and Sensei needed to ask for her permission in order to hand them over to the GSC. Arona herself still has incredible power as an AI, able to fend off a hacking attempt from Decagrammaton with a mere sneeze in her sleep when Millenium's main supercomputer was hacked in seconds. 

Reality Warping Protection Powers: When Trinity was attacked with a cruise missile during the Eden Treaty, Sensei was at ground zero of the explosion yet ended up relatively unharmed. Arona then tells Sensei that she can't protect him for much longer, meaning that she somehow managed to protect Sensei from the Shittim Chest and had enough power to nullify damage from a cruise missile. It's entirely possible that she has been using this power throughout Sensei's time in Kivotos, protecting Sensei from harm as he commands the students during the many battles waged together with them. This power has an energy limit however, as protecting Sensei from the missile, she was unable to protect Sensei from being shot by Saori afterward. Although it's still unclear if Arona's providing this power or if it's the Shittim Chest itself, this ability has been proven to be life-changing, especially for Sensei who spends a huge chunk of their time in the midst of gunfire without the bullet resistance provided by halos.

Both Arona and the GSC President share the same complexity and resemblances.

Arona is programmed to accompany Sensei throughout their adventures in Kivotos, providing information, aid, and protection through the Shittim Chest. Occasionally, Arona would make videos that providing information or are just Arona simply having fun with Sensei in her channel named Arona Channel.

After the events of Volume F, Plana resides in the same Shittim Chest Arona is living in. Though due to the Shittim Chest having problems with handling two AIs, Arona has been sleeping more frequently than she normally does.

Although the Shittim Chest where Arona lives was left behind by the General Student Council President, Arona seems to have little to no information about her.

entries.name: Plana
entries.content:
Plana, formerly known as A.R.O.N.A, is a non-playable character in Blue Archive that resides in the Shittim Chest alongside Arona.

The main OS of the Shittim Chest and Arona from another timeline. She is the manifestation of the damaged Shittim Chest from alternate timeline shot by Shiroko Terror, before reactivating when Phrenapates appeared.

Unlike Arona, despite also being the AI of the Shittim Chest, Plana generally spoke with simple commands, such as "understood." However, after parting with Phrenapates, she begins speaking more normally, though she often still speaks like a stereotypical computer AI by using simple formal response phrases. She calls Arona "Arona-senpai".

Plana is a small girl with long white hair that extends below her waist and bangs cover her right eye. Her hair has a mild red gradient as it goes down, and she has a braid on her right side that looks like a double-helix with a red halo around where it's tied. She has dark gray irises, but her right pupil is very pale blue, while her left pupil is red.

Plana wears a black sailor uniform with white piping on the edges of the collar that's tied with a white ribbon, a black pleated skirt that reaches just above her knees, black stockings, black loafers, and a long black coat.

Her halo is a simple red ring. Much like Arona, her halo changes depending on her mood.

She appears to be carrying a long-ranged rifle, likely to be a two-toned black and white Pattern 1914 Enfield bolt action battle rifle, wrapped in black shroud, similarly to Shimoe Koharu's, though she is holding it by her two hands,

Unlike the original Shittim Chest, the password for this version is reversed, swapping Jericho and Seven.
"We long for the wailing of Jericho. We bear the seven koans."
Plana appears on the chalkboard in the opening sequence of the 3rd PV, causing some to believe that the 1st year anniversary takes place after the events of the final volume.
In an interview with isakusan, he mentioned how Volume F has been in development for 5 years and that he's been dropping hints of it ever since its development. Plana's subtle appearance on the whiteboard appears to be one of these hints.
The name "Plana" comes from the word "Planetarium," after Arona's wish for Plana to illuminate her surroundings with a warm light like a planetarium, rather than like a solitary, fleeting star.
After completing the Final Volume, Plana will begin appearing in the combat selection menu alongside Arona with extra interactions, voice lines, and background changes.

entries.name: Phrenapates
entries.content:
Phrenapates is a non-playable character in Blue Archive who serves as the leader of the Iridescent Vanguard or "Guide of Chroma" in Global, and an adult. They are one of the two main antagonists of Volume F alongside Shiroko Terror.

The leader of the Iridescent Vanguard, leading the Iridescence's invasion to Kivotos. Alongside Shiroko Terror and Plana, they appear to seek to bring Kivotos to its destined end. However, It wasn't all it seemed.

At the end of chapter three to the beginning of chapter 4 Volume Finale, it's revealed that Phrenapates, the Guide of Chroma, is an Alternate Sensei from a different timeline. It was implied through some flashbacks during the GSC President's extended dialogue with Sensei that Phrenapates' timeline was destroyed, with all but himself, his A.R.O.N.A and Shiroko surviving.
