In this timeline, Alternate Sensei was injured so severally that they were comatose, with the doctors treating a life-threatening injury to his face for over 70 days. One night, Alternate Sensei suddenly wakes up from their coma, much to the shock of doctors. They decide to walk outside determined to save one more student despite intense injuries (including the steel mask that was holding their face together).

As they went to an alleyway, however, Shiroko (consumed by the Chroma) attacks them, shooting at Alternate Sensei's Shittim Chest, leaving multiple bullet holes. However, Shiroko fails in destroying the Shittim Chest, stating that she can't bring herself to kill Sensei and starts to break down. Just then, the Nameless Priests notices the interest of Chroma to Sensei due to the desire of them to protect their students, despite Shiroko Terror's plead not to, stating from the Priests that Sensei will now be a slave as the Guide of Chroma. However, Sensei actually used that ability to escort Shiroko Terror and their other considered student: A.R.O.N.A, into Sensei's parallel world, and during the events of Volume F Chapter 4, they fought against Sensei and the other Shiroko, until they are defeated

Their original name is exactly the same as the Sensei's name. After being exposed to the Iridescence, their appearance changed dramatically. By the Nameless Priests, they are formally known as the "False Sensei - Phrenapates". They are Sensei from another timeline who contacted the Iridescence (also known as "The Chroma" in Global) while at the verge of death for the sake of fulfilling their final duty as a teacher.

Before dying, Phrenapates entrusted their students to their alternate timeline counterpart, knowing they would do the same if they were in their position. As Phrenapates disappeared into nothingness, Sensei solemnly nodded in understanding and reached out to activate the last teleportation slot on Shiroko Terror, sacrificing their own chance at escape for Phrenapates' student.

Despite being endeavored by the Chroma, Phrenapates' personality is the exact same with Sensei's, always wanting to look out for their students.
Just like their name implies, Phrenapates is a deceiver. They were able to deceive so well that they even fooled the Nameless Priests, all in an attempt to save the last of their students: Shiroko Terror and Plana.

Phrenapates seems to have a mummy-like appearance without clothing, noted their hand. They wear a gray mask, a large, long gray cloak with bulky shoulder guards and wires, and a gray crown-like headwear.

Like their alternate counterpart, Sensei, Phrenapates uses the Adult Card, known as Credit Card on Global), but it's rusted.

The name "Phrenapates" originates from the greek word "φρεναπάτης" (phrenapatēs), which means "deceiver."
Phrenapates' death is currently the second death in Blue Archive history, following Kuchinashi Yume's death.
In Phrenapates' death CG, an origami crane can be seen next to them. This led some people to believe that it's the same crane that Sensei had during the 3rd PV but from another timeline. [1]
Phrenapates' mask design may be inspired by King Baldwin IV's portrayal in the 2005 film Kingdom of Heaven
If you complete either episode 7 or 8 (around the same time when you defeat Phrenapates), you'll be able to use their burned credit card in the items menu. Using it will give you 1200 Pyroxene, enough for a free 10-pull, but the card will be destroyed, leaving behind credit card shards, its last remains of Phrenapates' card. As of this moment, this process is irreversible.
There is an incident in CN where the card suddenly appeared earlier during Hyakkiyako summer event and Hoshino swimsuit banner. However, the card was later blocked from usage and was turned into shards later on, in which the game's official account reported was an accidental bug.
The theme when Sensei turns into Phrenapates is called Responsibility, which shows the desire of them wanting to protect their remaining students, despite being in grave danger themselves.

entries.name: Beatrice
entries.content:
Beatrice is a non-playable character in Blue Archive who is a member of Gematria and an adult.

She is the main antagonist of the second half of Volume 3.

Alias: Phantasm of All Pilgrims, The MacGuffin, Stage Setting.
Age: ?
Birthday: ?
Height: ?
School Club / Affiliation(s): Gematria, Arius Branch School (Formerly)
Occupation: Terrorist, Student Council President (Formerly)
Hobby: Spreading Pain and Death, Instilling Hatred onto Students.

For Science!: Much like her colleague Black Suit, Beatrice is interested in knowing. Unlike him, she's interested in unraveling the secrets of Kivotos itself and the world it's part of, rather than focusing on the Mystics of students...and she believes that sacrificing Atsuko in a ritual will grant her the knowledge she seeks.
Greater-Scope Villain: Was this for the first 3 Chapters of Volume 3, being the leader of Arius supporting and directing their efforts against Trinity and Gehenna while staying out of the spotlight completely until Chapter 4 rolled around.
Hope Crusher: Beatrice's indoctrination routine for the Arius Students, as alluded to in Saori's flashback in Another Me, revolves around convincing them that they have no hope for a brighter, more pleasant future and all they can do is accept their miserable lot and serve her unquestioningly. She even mentions destroying all the organs and gramophones to stop any students from playing uplifting songs, ensuring they stay angry, vengeful, and miserable.
Humiliation Conga: Suffers this in Kyrie For Courageous Girls and Beloved. First, she severely misunderstands Sensei as a person, leading to an angry, flabbergasted rant as she tries to work out what they are; her One-Winged Angel form is beaten twice by the Arius Squad under Sensei's leadership; her guards fail to show up when she summons them thanks to Mika's Hold the Line action; and she needs to be bailed out by fellow Gematria member Golconde, who makes it very clear to her that she's not in fact The Hero, nor is Sensei her personal villain, outright calling her "an insignificant plot device".
Hypocrite: She drills in Arius's "vanitas vanitatum, et omnia vanitas" motto into her student's heads in order to keep them under her thumb, but she herself is incredibly vain, and everything she does is for the sake of feeding her own self-importance.
I Will Punish Your Friend for Your Failure: Uses this threat to keep the Arius Squad doing her bidding, repeatedly threatening to sacrifice Atsuko in a dark ritual unless they do as she asks. Then she goes ahead and has Atsuko used for the ritual anyway.
Knight of Cerebus: While Volume 3 was already veering into a quite dark territory with Mika's coup attempt, the (attempted) assassination of Seia, and Azusa's willingness to become a murderer herself to stop Saori and protect her friends, Beatrice's introduction ramps things up even further. She's taken complete control of Arius Branch and rules the students through fear while indoctrinating them with her philosophy into an army willing to fight and kill for her, she's plotting a ritual using Human Sacrifice as fuel, abducts and tortures Seia when the latter spies on her via dreams and is the first Gematria member to explicitly order Sensei killed off to stop them interfering.
Knight Templar: Going off of Beatrice's dialogue when she's finally confronted face-to-face, she genuinely seems to see herself as The Hero trying to save Kivotos with her ritual with Sensei as the Designated Villain, even calling them "my antagonist". Unfortunately, she's a vicious, abusive torturer that's very out of place in the world of Blue Archive and is a Dark Messiah at best even if her goals of salvation are sincere, and winds up losing to Sensei and the Arius Squad.
More Deadly Than the Male: For all of their plans and strategies against the other schools and students, neither Black Suit nor Maestro has acted against Sensei directly, with Maestro barely interacting with them and Black Suit trying to recruit them, then giving in and forking over Hoshino's location without complaint when it's clear he can't sway Sensei. Beatrice, meanwhile, is insistent that Sensei needs to be killed to stop them from interfering with her plans. She's also the only known Gematria member to have a One-Winged Angel transformation that she uses to fight personally.
Ms. Fanservice: Compared to her compatriots, Beatrice is decidedly more conventionally attractive, lacking Maestro's two heads or Black Suit's mineral-Esque skin and instead wearing quite a revealing Sexy Backless Outfit accentuating her sprite's Boobs-and-Butt Pose. Even the multi-eyed headpiece that covers the top half of her head does little to detract from her looks.
The Needs of the Many: Reveals this as part of her motivation in Agnus Dei, insisting that her 'ascension' is in fact necessary to save Kivotos, and arguing that one sacrificial lamb (that being Atsuko) is a small price to pay for the power and knowledge to save everyone else.
No-Nonsense Nemesis: Where Black Suit and Maestro either attempted to recruit or avoided Sensei when carrying out their plans, Beatrice fully recognizes the threat they can pose and plots to have them killed as soon as possible.
Beatrice: "Their interference would alter the meaning of all that I possess. They are dangerous."
Beatrice: "That's when I realized in order to bring my plan to fruition, I must eliminate Sensei before all else."
Demonstrated nicely in Chapter 4 of the Trinity Arc, where Beatrice's immediate response to Sensei turning down her offer of a partnership is to sic Justina Saint Guardians on him and the Arius Squad, ordering them terminated at once.
Omnicidal Maniac: Having gone mad from her defeat at the hands of the Sensei, Beatrice deliberately reveals the location of Kivotos to the Chroma, which would result in not just the destruction of the Sensei and Schale, but the entire city and everybody in it.
The Promise: She made one to the Arius Squad that she wouldn't sacrifice Atsuko if they continue doing her dirty work. In truth, she never intended to follow through and tries to kill them after their purpose is done.
Theme Naming: Named after Beatrice from The Divine Comedy. She refers to herself as a Visionary of Pilgrims, and during her first meeting with Sensei, she compares the Arius that has been taken over by her as a 'Paradise' exclusively for adults, where adults dominate, exploit and prey on children.
This Cannot Be!: As her Villainous Breakdown progresses due to the Humiliation Conga she receives through the V3C4 finale, she repeatedly exclaims disbelief at how these things are happening, not understanding how her first One-Winged Angel attempt was beaten, feeling confusion and rage at how the "Kyrie Eleison" / "Hymn of Mercy" managed to play despite deliberately breaking every source of music that could perform it, and then when her second attempt at transforming to defeat Sensei fails she falls into despair unable to accept or comprehend how she lost.
Too Dumb to Live: She boasts that she's in league with the Chroma to the rest of Gematria, despite knowing that Gematria are vehemently opposed to the Chroma and would have no qualms killing her to put a stop to her plans.
Tyrant Takes the Helm: Has already seized control of Arius Branch and its autonomous district by the time the story shifts to focus on them, and her rule is apparently bad enough that most of the students fear her. Near the end of Chapter 4, it's outright confirmed, both by the Arius Squad and Beatrice herself, that she keeps her students miserable and angry on purpose to allow her to exploit them better. Later, it's shown that she wants to expand her tyrannical control to all of existence.
Vile Villain, Saccharine Show: Beatrice is extremely off place for the setting of Blue Archive in-general. While most other villains are mitigated by either being somewhat comedic, have redeeming qualities or in Mika's case, too detached from reality, Beatrice is essentially Agatha Trunchbull waltzing into a more-or-less light-hearted waifu gacha game to wreck havoc with her horrific physical and psychological abuse. Even compared to her other Gematria brethren, she sticks out.
Villainous Breakdown: She doesn't take it well when her One-Winged Angel form is beaten, twice, by the Arius Squad, first in Agnus Dei and second in Beloved, her composure shattering as she's reduced to angrily screaming and then weakly moaning that everything was in place and there's no way she should have lost.
Villain: Exit, Stage Left: Fellow Gematria member Golconde arrives to collect Beatrice after she's beaten in Beloved, allowing her to escape to plot another day since the Arius Squad is busy tending to Atsuko and Sensei is a Non-Action Guy who can't actually stop him.
We Can Rule Together: During her encounter with Sensei in Chapter 4, Beatrice tries to entice them to allow the ritual to go ahead by pointing out all the secrets of the world they can uncover together. Sensei, being who they are, turns down the offer, adamantly refusing to accept anything that involves sacrificing a student.
Beatrice: "It is the duty of an adult to bring salvation to all. And that is accomplished by ascending to a higher existence. And that is exactly why I have prepared this ritual. By utilizing a power foreign to Kivotos, I shall ascend to a higher existence. And once I have climbed to such lofty heights, I shall bring salvation to this world. Such is the ultimate destination any adult must strive for!"
Wrong Genre Savvy: Lampshaded by Golconde when the rest of Gematria finish her off, as he chides Beatrice on her ambition.
Golconde: "Oh dear, oh dear. Our poor Madame has not read enough storybooks. Side characters who strive to become the protagonist never make it to the ending."
You Have Outlived Your Usefulness:
She makes the Arius Squad do her dirty work so she won't sacrifice Atsuko, but later decides to do so anyway, even trying to kill them.
On the receiving end of this by the rest of Gematria early through the Final Volume, after she reveals that on top of attempting to control the Chroma she has given the Chroma the location of Kivotos and quite possibly doomed them all, which leaves Beatrice a liability.

entries.name: Black Suit
entries.content:
Black Suit is a non-playable character in Blue Archive who is a historian and archaeologist, a member of Gematria, and an adult. He is the overall main antagonist of the Main Story.

Alias: Black Suit (by Hoshino), Kurofuku (in Japanese).
Age: ?
Birthday: ?
Height: ?
School Club / Affiliation(s): Gematria, Kaiser Corporation (Associate, formerly)
Occupation: Historian, Archaeologist
Hobby: Researching the Nameless Priests, Technologies and Mysteries of Kivotos and Sensei.
Goals: Make Sensei a member of Gematria. Make Abydos High School bankrupt. Inject Hoshino with Terror. Form a temporary alliance with the academies of Kivotos to destroy the colors. (almost succeeded, but failed)
Powers / Skills: Genius-Level Intelligence, Strategic Leadership, Mastery of Manipulation, Master Tactician, Military Training, Charisma Mastery, Unarmed, Combat Proficiency, Master Martial Artist, Mastery of Intimidation, Master Combatant, 
Adaptive Combatant
Artificially Enhanced Physiology: Supernatural Strength, Supernatural Durability, Supernatural Endurance, Superhuman Reflexes, Superhuman Survivability, Superhuman Mobility, Superhuman Stamina, Supernatural Evasion, Superhuman Adaptability, Superhuman Dexterity, Superhuman Senses, Superhuman Agility, Supernatural Accuracy, Near-Absolute Regeneration, Limitless Invulnerability, Contaminant Immunity, Self-Sustenance.
Crimes: Abuse of power, Psychological abuse, Torture, Terrorism, Conspiracy
Mass property damage by proxy
Kidnapping, Illegal experimentation, Corruption, Fraud.
Type of Villain: Enigmatic Mastermind.

Black Suit serves as a member of Gematria, a group of researchers looking into the mysteries of Kivotos. He played the role of the antagonist during Chapters 1 and 2 in 'The Foreclosure Task Force' Main Story Volume, where he abducted Takanashi Hoshino and used her as his guinea pig. Black Suit's primary focus was researching Decagrammaton's exploits, but a setback in their research led to a temporary disbandment of Gematria.

Unlike typical villains, Black Suit plays by the rules. Though he often exploits the loopholes that exist within contracts he made, he resigns if the contract is invalid. Black Suit remains composed in nearly every situation and admits his mistakes when deemed necessary,

The name 'Black Suit' originated from Takanashi Hoshino, who met him in the past and called him such. Black Suit was fond of the given name, and has since used it as his own.

A member of the enigmatic group who call themselves Gematria and an ancient technology historian and archaeologist. He is an adult and, much like Sensei, an outsider to Kivotos. He does not regard the students' livelihood as important. However, does this truly make him a bad adult?

Despite being a villain, Black Suit plays his role as a villain while still playing by the rules. He abides by the rules and methods that exist in Kivotos and follows the terms and conditions inside the contracts he made, only occasionally exploiting the loopholes that exist within those contracts. In addition to how obedient he is with the rules, he also tends to be composed in almost every situation, only raising his voice once during his first conversation with Sensei. He acts rather calm and even admits his mistakes whenever necessary.

Black Suit is mysterious and enigmatic, and he values research and pragmatism. He's willing to do anything to satisfy his research, and has been shown to get what he wants through fraudulent contracts.

He values "contracts", which seem to be literally a force that makes both parties irrevocable contracts, not just contracts on paper. Due to the nature of his ability, the consent of the other party is also indispensable, so he takes advantage of his manipulation and a method close to fraud by piercing the gap between the contents of the contract. Among the things obtained through this contract, Black Suit uses a lot of science and technology as his "main weapons", and although it is not the technology he developed, he also created a defense program that can block even halo destruction bombs.

Black Suit also seems to be procuring weapons from the outside of Kivotos or the Ruins, and the hypersonic cruise missile that flew into Trinity in Vol. 3 was also brought by him. Also, looking at the Kaiser Corporation's support to the extent of encroaching on Kivotos, it seems that if you join hands with him, you can provide funds and legal rights to run a large-scale private military company branch. It seems that one of his contracts is that he enlists Decagrammaton's Ten Prophets and launches an all-out war against the teacher when he wants.

Black Suit truly respects Sensei and has honor for him. As an example, he considers them a colleague who will share his will, admits that negotiations with them having broken down, informs them that Hoshino is detained by Kaiser PMC and that they are trying to inject fear into her, When Kivotos was invaded by the Iridencence by Beatrice, he temporarily disbanded Gematria for his comrades' safety and formed a temporary alliance with Sensei, SCHALE, and the academies in Kivotos. Tried to thwart the invasion.

Black Suit has an eerie appearance, possessing glossy black "skin" with cracks and other deformations. These deformations create what resembles a face, in the form of an opening for a right eye and a mouth. From the cracks, a pale blue glow is emitted. The top of his head emits what appears to be black smoke.

True to his alias, Black Suit wears a black suit. Paired with his suit is a white dress shirt, a black lounge jacket, a black necktie, black trousers, black shoes, and black gloves.

A member of Gematria who first appeared in the story. Black Suit is seen collaborating with the Kaiser Corporation to conduct an experiment. Several years before Chalet's teacher arrived, he had been continuously offering to recruit Hoshino Takanashi on the condition of debt relief, but Hoshino, who refused, eventually accepted his offer for the sake of his colleagues as he could not withstand Kaiser's tyranny at the point of the first chapter. Now, he want to take her away, imprison her, and instill fear in her. At this time, if the Kaiser Corporation takes over Abydos High School and creates a private school under the control of the corporation, it would be an interesting enough experiment, and Hoshino despairs.

However, when Sensei who had been following Hoshino came to visit, Black Suit greeted them politely and responded logically, saying, "She has already written a letter of resignation and came voluntarily, but is it not respecting her to leave her alone?' The letter of resignation has no effect, so unless she, the current advisor teacher, gives permission, she is still a student that I must protect." Sensei takes out the "Credit Card", but rather, Black Suit himself stays silent for a while and desperately persuades Sensei to stop him. According to the black suit, he has to pay the price of life and time in using the Credit Card.

However, when Sensei eventually refused to give up despite Black Suit's desperate persuasion, he admitted that the negotiations had broken down, and informed them that Hoshino was detained in Kaiser PMC and that they were trying to experiment to inject fear into her. Black Suit left the word that he would keep an eye on Sensei from now on and withdrew.

Afterwards, Sensei relayed information about Black Suit to the student council, but unlike the wanted Kaiser PMC director, they couldn't find any clues about the man in black suit.

Volume F: Where All Miracles Begin
After the Divi:Sion and Eden Treaty incident, they were puzzled that even the Ark of Atra-Hasis was observed as a result of the arrival of variables that even they could not control at the Gematria meeting again. Then, when he said that the color was coming here by observing Kivotos through Beatrice, he intervened saying that the possibility would be low based on the 'probability theory', but Beatrice spit out the remark that he contacted the color himself and passed over the coordinates of Kivotos. Upon hearing this, even the black suit was taken off the crane, and as the maestro, who had previously gnashed his teeth at Beatrice, expelled Beatrice unanimously, and in a frenzy at this, even receiving the power of color, Beatrice, who became a monster, was easily subdued through the weapon against color with the party. After that, they deal with it, and casually ask to discuss the vacancy later.

Afterwards, under the assumption that the six energy bodies discovered by the Student Council were colors, Gematria tried to proceed with Parusia, which was their plan, much earlier than expected. but suddenly Shiroko's Bad Future variant appears through a portal in front of the black suit. And even in a sudden situation, he sees in an instant that Anubis's identity is Shiroko's Bad Future variant, and leaves a promise for the future to what extent he even expected this.

In Chapter 2, he reappears with a cracked face that can't even keep the shape of his face, probably because he was severely beaten by a variant of Shiroko who uses the name of Anubis. It informs that Gematria has been destroyed and delivers basic information to the teacher to deal with the color. Afterwards, he advises the teacher who wants to use the adult card that if he abuses the card, he will face the same end as them.

Afterwards, after temporarily restoring Maestro's body and sharing the information that Golcomte has transformed into Francis, they declare that they will temporarily disband Gematria for Maestro's safety, as they will only be taken away by the colors no matter what they explore. After that, he summoned the teacher who was looking for a way to stop the invasion of color to the meeting hall of Gematria and confirmed his determination to do anything to return the terrorized sirocco to the teacher. Along with the advice that he could die, he informs us of the existence of the ancient space battleship 'Utnapishtim's Ship' buried in the Abydos desert, which was built to deal with Atrahasis' ark.

Afterwards, he convinces the teacher that what he is doing now is to challenge the future, which has already been destroyed, and that it would be easier to go back to the past and kill Shiroko. It only reaffirmed the teacher's unbreakable will that it is duty, and in the end, you watch the teacher heading to space asking if he is going to help the student.

What Make Him Magnificent?
He is a mysterious and enigmatic being who is unknown, and he is attractive and interesting as a character who solves the ridiculous in an exciting way. also, his theme is very cool.
While he is the de facto leader of the Gematria, he respects the other members of the Gematria, not as subordinates, but as researchers like himself who are on equal footing to explore the mysteries of Kivotos, and in the case of the Maestro, even though he doesn't see eye to eye with him, he seems to appreciate him.
As a seeker of Kivotos, he recognizes madness as an enemy to be overcome, and he is wary of falling into madness more than anyone else, and he values pragmatism. Also, the way he runs Gematria is solely for the purpose of exploration and rescue, and he doesn't like to cling to power like Beatrice or have ambitions to become a god of the new world.
He studied the technology of Decagrammaton, making the prophets of Decagrammaton into their own puppet, using the technology of the unknown priests to create supersonic cruise missiles, Halo protection masks and healing drones.
He enclosed the prophets of Decagrammaton and led them to terrorism toward Kivotos, and used the techniques of the unknown priests obtained through the contract to create supersonic cruise missiles, Halo protective masks and healing drones. He has no original combat power, but with a number of science and technology as a weapon, he has been a big threat in Kivotos without combat skills.
Sensei thinks of him as an enemy, but he thinks Sensei is a true friend and that he will do with him. Therefore, he genuinely care in Sensei.
Although he is aiming for some research purposes of Kivotos, he does not like him because of his psychological abuse from Hoshino Takanashi, but he acknowledged his defeat in front of Sensei and informed Hoshino's kidnapping, and Sensei is an adult's adult When he tried to use the card, he advised that using an adult card reduced the life of Sensei.
After Gematria was destroyed by Anubis (Bad Future Shiroko), and all of their research was robbed by Color, he informed Sensei about Color, and warned Sensei that if he abused his adult card, he would meet the same tragic end as they did.
Also, he does not really want Sensei to die. Sensei, who was looking for a way to stop the invasion of color, was called to the head of Gematria and confirmed that he could do anything to reverse the terrorized Shiroko to Sensei. Along with the advice, it tells the existence of the ancient space battleships buried in the Avidos desert, which was created to deal with the ark of Atra Hash. This shows that he is really worried about Sensei.
After stopping the invasion of color, he sent a greeting card at S.C.H.A.L.E's one-year anniversary party.
His manipulation of the Kaiser Corporation PMC director to conduct the experiments on the students of Abydos, and his support of Kaiser Corporation to the point of controlling Kivotos, gives him the funding and legal right to roll a massive PMC if he works with them. He also shows that he is very intelligent by preparing a way out in case the operation fails, by blaming the Kaiser PMC director for all the crimes he committed within Abydos.
He once succeeded in manipulating Hoshino Takanashi, the Vice President of the Student Council and now the Vice President of the Foreclosure Task Force, into a fraudulent deal with her.
He is basically a cheater because he shows his benefits through a fraudulent contract, but at the same time, he has an honorable side. As an example, he confronts the Terrorization of Sensei and Hoshino, but when Sensei has eventually broken down when his desperate persuasion is not bent, Hoshino is detained in Kaiser PMC and they are injected against Hoshino. After telling him that he was trying to do an experiment, Gematria left the saying that he would watch the teacher in the future, and he showed his honor to recognize his defeat.
When Beatrice pointed out that he failed to achieve his purpose in Avidos' meetings, he talked about Sensei, the cause of failure. Turning Sensei as an enemy has a very large risk, so he must be greeted as a colleague, and he doesn't like to kill Sensei because he thinks Sensei is a friend. And he is wary of Beatrice's radicals, but because Beatrice is basically a member of Gematria, he respects her way formally, but after that is due to Beatrice, He does not like her radical.
With Maestro and Golconde & Decalcomanie, he prepared for the betrayal of Beatrice in advance, and when he found out that Beatrice would call the color to Kivotos and slaughter all the creatures in Kivotos, he calmed down the actions of Beatrice. He felt disgusted and deported from Gematria and at the same time executed Beatrice using the Color counterpart weapon.
In order to prepare for the color, he tried to prepare for the attack of the color by trying to proceed with the parousia, which was their plan, much earlier than expected.
After temporarily repairing the Maestro's body after it was attacked by Anubis and sharing the information that Golcante has been transformed into Francis, he declares that whatever they explore now will only be taken away by the Colors, and that he is temporarily disbanding Gematria for the Maestro's safety. This suggests that he genuinely cares about his fellow members of the Gematria, with the exception of Beatrice.
He gave information about Utnapishtim's ship at no cost from Sensei, which played a huge role in helping Sensei and the students save Kivotos from the colors, which made him an On & Off Anti-Hero even though he had sociopathy. make it with Moreover, if you consider that he is a master, pragmatism and a contract-oriented personality, this proves that he truly did Heroic Deed out of concern for Sensei, not pragmatism.
Ultimately, he is karma Houdini as he survives unaccounted for all the crimes he has committed by the On & Off Anti-Hero.

He used Decagrammaton's robots, BINAH, CHESED, and HOD, to lead numerous destruction and terrorism in Kivotos.
He manipulated the Kaiser Corporation into a fraudulent contract with Hoshino, offering to pay off Abydos High's debt. He also tried to ruin Abydos High School for his experiments.
He kidnapped Hoshino and tried to commit an experiment to inject Terror into Hoshino, and if the Kaiser Corporation took over Abydos High School, which is no different than Hoshino's precious home, and a private school under the control of a private company would be interesting enough. He said that it was not an experiment and inflicted psychological abuse on Hoshino. Besides, Black Suit has only admitted that he was defeated by Sensei, and still has no regrets about the psychological abuse and cruel experiments he subjected Hoshino to. This proves that he is a ruthless sociopath.
He provided Beatrice with the defense program used by the nameless priests, which means he was somewhat complicit in her crimes. However, this is an evaluation that the black suit did not cooperate because they liked Beatrice's crime, but only pragmatism, and they do not have the right to do what they do with her means, so do whatever you want, but that method will obviously interfere with Sensei. While doing so, he revealed that he would no longer cooperate with Beatrice's crimes.

He allied himself with the Kaiser Corporation to run experiments towards Abydos High School for his own amusement.
He instigated Kaiser PMC Director oppressing Abydos High School behind the scenes to experiment with instilling fear into Hoshino.
He had been trying to recruit Hoshino for years before Sensei came to Abydos, offering to forgive Abydos's debts in exchange for an experiment to inject Terror into Hoshino, and his behind-the-scenes maneuvering led the Kaiser PMC director to drive Abydos's debts even higher, forcing Hoshino to sign with him directly.
He locked Hoshino in a lab and sadistically asked her if it wouldn't be an interesting enough experiment if the Abydos School was taken over by the Kaiser Corporation and made into a private school under private control.
He justifies his actions with the logic that those with more power exploit those without, and those with more knowledge exploit those without.
When his experiment ended in failure, he got away with it because he blamed the Kaiser PMC director for all the crimes he had committed within Abydos.
He provided Beatrice with the Defense Program of the Nameless Priests, indirectly aiding Beatrice in her crimes.
Despite the Blue Archive's high standards, the experiments the Black Suit is about to perpetrate on Hoshino are so unique and brutal that he meets the standards for heinous enough. Also, he only admitted to being defeated by Sensei, but still has no regrets about the psychological torture and cruel experiments he subjected to on Hoshino.

What Make Him Inconsistent?
He is on & off with a few anti-heroic roles. He shows that he is willing to perform many heroic acts for Sensei, whom he considers his friend. Furthermore, although he is contract-oriented and pragmatic, he gave Sensei information about the Boat of Utnapishtim during the invasion of The Colors, including Iridescent, without receiving anything in return, and without his information, Kivotos would have been destroyed by Bad Future Shiroko.
He genuinely cares for and respects Sensei. He encouraged Sensei to join Gematria, and when his plan was thwarted by Sensei, he showed the honor of admitting defeat and freeing Hoshino. He also insisted to Beatrice that turning Sensei into an enemy was too risky and that she should welcome him as an ally, and he sought Sensei out during the Iridescent invasion and genuinely advised him that Gematria was gone and that if he played the grown up card too much, he would meet the same tragedy as they had.
He has genuine respect for the other members of Gematria except for Beatrice. First of all, Gematria is not a group that seeks world domination, but rather a group of researchers who have come together for their own research purposes, so there is no leader; he only acts as a mediator and sees the other members, except for Beatrice, as researchers on an equal footing with him. He is also wary of Beatrice because she does not fit in with Gematria's ideology and wants to kill Sensei unconditionally, and he wants to use the artistic values they have created simply as a terrorism and war tool.
He has some standards, He's very wary of abandoning his position as a researcher and descending into madness, and expresses disgust at Beatrice's plan to wipe out the entire human population of Kivotos by calling in chroma just for the petty reason of losing to Sensei.

Affably Evil: He's very polite and courteous towards Sensei when they finally meet in person, even after he starts losing his patience as he tries and fails to understand why Sensei keeps on insisting on Hoshino's return despite it not being his problem whatsoever. When he finally realizes he can't sway Sensei into giving up, he relents and freely gives away Hoshino's location, allowing Sensei to leave without complaint.
An Offer You Can't Refuse: While an actual gun is never used as a threat during their meeting, Black Suit has a metaphorical gun to the Task Force's heads when making his offer to Hoshino: since Abydos owes their debt to the Kaiser Corporation and Black Suit is an associate of theirs, he can easily convince the Kaiser Director to simply inflate Abydos' debt over and over again until they drown in it and have no choice but to default on the loan, forcing Hoshino to sign herself away to save her school or watch it go under anyway.
Appropriated Appellation: Hoshino calls him "Black Suit" in part due to his enigmatic nature and his offers, and he "grows fond" of the epithet to let Sensei use it as his name.
Cut Lex Luthor a Check: He admits that his plots to recover the technology of the Nameless Priests are mostly so that he can sell it off the black market for huge profits.
Evil Cannot Comprehend Good: Black Suit can't understand why Sensei handed over control of the Sanctum Tower to the General Student Council, as opposed to seizing it, and with it control of Kivotos and all of its Mystics, for themselves. He also refutes Sensei's assertion that an adult takes responsibility for others, calling them ignorant and insisting that being an adult is about being in charge of and controlling those others instead.
Black Suit: "Adults rule the aimless with authority, the ignorant with knowledge, and the weak with power. That is what it means to be an adult."
For Science!: He reacts with distaste when Hoshino assumes that she's going to be made to work for Kaiser PMC in exchange for Black Suit clearing away Abydos' debt, assuring her that he would never waste "the most promising Mystic in Kivotos" on such menial labor. He instead explains that he wants to understand how Hoshino and her Mystics work... by any means necessary.
Black Suit: "My objective is to study, analyze and understand Takanashi Hoshino. You, in other words, are our guinea pig."
Friendly Enemy: Toward Sensei. Black Suit genuinely respects (and even seems to like) him, is unfailingly polite toward him in their interactions, and ideally would very much like to not be his enemy.
Mad Scientist: Though he never gets the chance to do any proper experiments on her, it's Black Suit's self-proclaimed mission to study Hoshino and her Mystics, while his willingness to support Kaiser's efforts to annex Abydos and what he does to Hoshino once he finally gets his hands on her more than covers the 'Mad' part of this trope.
The Man Behind the Man: He's this for the Kaiser PMC Director, supporting his efforts to annex Abydos to eventually get his hands on Hoshino, in an effort to study her and her Mystics.
Person with the Clothing: Black Suit does, indeed, wear a black three-piece suit at all times.
The Rival: According to Beatrice, he considers himself this to Sensei, believing that the two of them will better each other through opposing one another even if Black Suit considers Sensei a comrade. This is why, in Volume F, he goes to Sensei to tell him how to reach the Ark: because he believes that he, if anyone, has a chance against the Chroma.
Suddenly Shouting: Devolves into this as he struggles to understand why Sensei won't just give up on getting Hoshino back.
We Can Rule Together: He makes an effort to try and recruit Sensei to his cause, insisting that neither he nor his faction wants to oppose Sensei. Though Sensei turns him down, Beatrice comments in Chapter 4 of the Trinity Arc that Black Suit still considers Sensei a comrade, believing that they can better each other.
Your Head A-Splode: Black Suit didn't get away from Anubis' attack unscathed, as during his subsequent encounter with Sensei, you can see that practically half of his head has been blown off, leaving an open wound that burns with white flame

entries.name: FTF Story
entries.content:
It was a beautiful day in Kivotos. Schale was just opened recently and news about Sensei had begun spreading slowly. At that time, Sensei was minding their own business until Arona notified them about a letter they just received. Arona then began summarizing it. It was a letter from a student named Okusora Ayane on behalf of Abydos High School who was requesting aid in the form of supplies and ammunition. "What? Students in need of help? Of course I will help!" was basically Sensei's reaction to that information. They then walked towards Abydos as quick as they understood the letter....Perhaps walking wasn't the greatest idea, especially considering the stuff Sensei's bringing. To make matters worse, Sensei was lost and had no way of telling where they were or where Abydos was located. As Sensei fell to the ground slowly losing consciousness, a student arrived with her bike and decided to help them. She introduced herself as Sunaookami Shiroko, a student of Abydos who just happened to be heading to school. She also gave Sensei her leftover energy drink and a piggyback ride to Abydos. As they arrived however, the students present mistook Sensei as a dead body. Oddly enough, they were more than ready to hide the body. As Shiroko dropped Sensei from her back, they introduced themselves as the Sensei of Schale. The students were shocked. Their request for aid was accepted! One of the students decided to wake up one of their friends and brought her into the meeting room. Of course, introductions were necessary. As they were about to introduce themselves though, they got interrupted by gunfire. It seems that the local gangsters, colloquially known as the Helmet Gang, were harassing the school again. Unfortunately for them, they didn't know that Abydos had Sensei by their side. The gangsters were easily defeated and forced to retreat. Back to where they were, it was time to introduce themselves. They are the Foreclosure Task Force, consisting of Ayane and Serika as the first-years, Nonomi and Shiroko as the second-years, and Hoshino as their lone third-year. Thanks to Sensei, they were able to fend off the gangsters. This gave Hoshino an idea. What if they went on the offensive for once? This was a brilliant idea considering how vulnerable the gangsters must be after the fight. It was time for them to head out and stop these gangsters for good. With Sensei's help, the gangsters now pose no problem for the FTC, allowing the girls to focus on more important matters. Serika's mouth accidentally slipped and mentioned about the school debt. Although the debt was no secret, Serika still felt the need to keep it a secret due to still not trusting Sensei, causing her to get angry when the others decided to involve Sensei with their matters and ran away. Hoshino and Ayane then explained about their concurrent 900 million yen and continuously increasing debt which was caused due to the school's heavy sandstorms and incompetent student council members. Of course, it was only natural for Sensei to want to help despite not knowing how. They're the new member of the Foreclosure Task Force after all. The next day, Sensei met Serika as they were heading to Abydos. She was still very untrusting towards Sensei and decided to head to where she originally headed to. Sensei proceeded by stalking her until they reached Shiba Seki, a ramen shop. They decided to bring in the rest of the FTC members. Here's where they found out about Serika's part-time job. The whole gang decided to eat there, heavily embarrassing Serika. Without any notice, Hoshino said that Sensei would be paying. With no choice, Sensei paid for the meal. A whole day of work has finished. Exhausted and still mad about the previous incident, Serika decided to head home. The others had already went home before her, leaving her alone at night. Serika then noticed how vacant the way home slowly became day by day. As she continued, a bunch of gangsters began attacking her. At first, Serika thought of this as a way to vent off steam, but she was outnumbered and outpowered. The gangsters overpowered her and rendered her unconscious, giving them the chance to kidnap her. A few hours later, Ayane noticed Serika's disappearance. The whole club became worried. Hoshino and Sensei went out to try and log in to the General Student Council's central communication network. Apparently, they did it without permission, so if they were to be found out, they'd be in big trouble. But it's all for Serika's sake. Putting that aside, they were able to locate where Serika was. With no time to waste, they headed out to rescue Serika. After regaining her consciousness, Serika noticed that she was in the middle of a wasteland. Feeling worried, she thought that this is where her road ends. The others might've thought that she betrayed them. As she began contemplating, an explosion happened, releasing her from where she was trapped in. The club members are here! And they noticed the currently crying Serika. The now flustered Serika also noticed Sensei and asked why they're here too. With the rescued Serika in their hands, now they just need to clear off the remaining gangsters. After returning back home safely, Ayane did some digging on the tank parts they collected during battle. Apparently, the parts were from an illegal model that has been prohibited within Kivotos. With this in mind, they now know that there's definitely something else going on behind the scenes. As they continued their digging, something else is going on in the darkness. As the gangsters were defeated, their boss can only do so much with them. He decided to hire some skilled professionals to do the job. Soon after, Serika woke up after resting due to her injuries. The first person to visit her was Sensei. Serika was thankful for their help, but she couldn't exactly convey her thanks due to her embarrassment.

The next day, the FTC began their regularly scheduled meeting to share ideas on how to deal with their debt, this time with Sensei in attendance. For some reason, the other members had very peculiar ideas to share. Serika fell for a pyramid scheme, Shiroko proposed that they rob a bank, Hoshino wanted to kidnap students from other schools to make them join Abydos, and Nonomi wanted to become pop idols. With such absurd ideas, Ayane went insane and flipped the table. To calm Ayane down, the FTC decided to take her to the ramen shop where Serika works at. While they were eating, a girl named Haruka entered the shop and asked Serika if there's any food in the menu that costs less than 600 yen. Serika told them about the regular Shiba Seki ramen which costs 580 yen. Hearing this, the girl invited her friends in. Apparently, the four of them wanted to share one bowl of ramen together. Feeling bad for them, Serika asked her boss if there's anything he can do for them. The boss then prepared one giant bowl of ramen for the same price just for them. The girls were more than grateful. Shiroko then noticed that the girls' uniforms were from Gehenna. After the Gehenna girls parted ways with the Abydos girls, Mutsuki, one of the girls, told Aru, the girl who was seemingly their boss, that those Abydos girls were from Abydos, the same school that they were paid to eliminate. Shocked by this reality check, Aru was rendered speechless. She felt like she was already close friends with those Abydos girls, but unfortunately, business is business. Aru then hired part-time students to attack Abydos. Unfortunately for them as well, Sensei was there leading Abydos, guaranteeing their victory. Aru's group was forced to retreat. The next day, Sensei encountered Ayane who was heading somewhere. She mentioned that there's a interest payment on the school's debt due today. As they were talking though, one of the previous attackers interrupted them. It was Mutsuki. For some reason, she was acting as if nothing happened yesterday between her group and Abydos. Of course, Ayane was infuriated, especially after what happened yesterday. After Mutsuki left, Ayane and Sensei returned back to Abydos. Moments later, a teller arrived to pick up the payment of Abydos' loan. As the teller left on a truck, the girls began wondering why those people only accepted cash and always bothered to pay for trucks as it seemed unnecessary. Afterwards, Ayane decided to tell the rest of the FTC about what she had discovered so far. The ones who attacked them were Problem Solver 68, a notorious group of delinquents who claimed to be a fixer agency. Eventually, they linked PS68 with the Black Market. With this as their current and only lead, they decided to head out to the Black Market in hopes of finding whoever is behind Abydos' harassment. As they arrived at the Black Market, the FTC saw a student being chased by thugs. The student ended up crashing into the FTC. The FTC noticed that the student belonged to Trinity judging by her uniform. Since she's from Trinity, the thugs thought the student would make for a nice ransom and decided to attack the FTC as well. Of course with Sensei there, the thugs were easily defeated. The girl thanked the FTC for saving her and introduced herself as Ajitani Hifumi. She said that she's in the Black Market to look for a discontinued piece of Peroro merchandise. The merchandise in question is a small chicken-looking plushie with an ice-cream shoved onto its mouth. Although peculiar-looking, only 100 of them were made, and she had to get her hands on one. The FTC then stated their purpose in the Black Market in return. In the middle of their conversation, more thugs began appearing. They need to act fast, but they don't wanna stir up too much trouble, so they chose to retreat. As they retreated, they found the Stygian Bank. As they looked closer, they noticed a familiar truck carrying loads of cash. They found out that it was the same truck the teller used to carry the cash the FTC paid for their debt. To think the money they worked hard for is being used to fund criminal activities. They need to stop it, and there's only one thing they could do. They must rob the Stygian Bank. Shiroko was excited while Hifumi was confused. Of course, they can't leave behind Hifumi, so Nonomi made a makeshift mask using a paper bag. As everyone prepared themselves, it was robbing time. Meanwhile, Aru was busy trying to get a loan inside the Stygian bank. Unfortunately, due to how bad Aru's business has been doing, the bank examiner couldn't accept her loan application, leading her to an emotional distress inside her head. All of a sudden, the lights went out, leading the employees to a panic as guns started firing. When the lights went back on, five robbers made their appearance, introducing themselves as the Masked Mizugi Gang. Despite the ability to grab as much money as they could, they only wanted the transport logs for the truck which had their debt money. As the employee gave Shiroko the logs, he also gave them a bag full of cash. Shiroko decided to bring it with her, and the gang made their escape. Meanwhile, Aru stood at the side, completely amazed by how the robbers managed to pull it off, not knowing those robbers are the Abydos girls. As the Masked Mizugi Gang went far enough from trouble, the others noticed the money bag. It's filled with at least 100 million yen. This would've helped reduce their burden by a lot, but Hoshino decided that it'd be best they leave the money alone. Before they headed back though, Aru managed to catch up to them and wanted to say how huge of an impression they left Aru with and how she now looks up to them and wants to be like them, still oblivious to who they are. As the Masked Mizugi Gang bid their farewell, they accidentally left the money bag, but they thought it'd be better that way as the bag would definitely go to someone who needs it. When PS68 noticed the bag, they decided to take it with them. As PS68 reached their office, Mutsuki decided to burst Aru's bubble and told her the truth about the Masked Mizuki Gang. Aru was devastated, as if she found out "Santa Claus isn't real."

Back at the Abydos building, the FTC, including Hifumi, held a meeting regarding the transport logs Shiroko brought. They discovered that the Helmet Gang were working under Kaiser Loans' orders. With this in mind, they knew that this isn't just simply a bank scheme. Hifumi decided to part ways with the FTC after the meeting was over. Meanwhile, PS68 weren't doing so well, especially Aru, who spent the night thinking about their next move. Kayoko suggested they just return back to Gehenna, but Aru didn't want that, especially when the Prefect Team exists. Kayoko knew about this and was already thinking far ahead. She knew that the Prefect Team is basically nothing without Sorasaki Hina, their head prefect. Unfortunately, that wasn't enough to calm Aru down, so they decided to go for some ramen. A few moments later, Sensei noticed Hoshino sleeping on Nonomi's lap. Nonomi wanted to give Sensei a try as well, but Hoshino called dibs. As Hoshino left, Nonomi talked a bit about Hoshino's past, how she wasn't always this laid-back and lazy, how she was quite strict and violent towards others, although she doesn't know much about it. While they talked about that, Hoshino went someplace quite distant from the school. There, she met quite a peculiar-looking person, and it seems he has a trade offer. Though Hoshino wanted to decline, the person had something else in mind. Back to PS68, as they arrived at the Shiba Seki Ramen shop, they were welcomed by the owner as they headed to their seats. As the others were waiting for their food however, something snapped inside Aru's mind. It seems she's found out the reason why she can't become an outlaw. "It's this shop! We're supposed to be working hard like outlaws! Not being in a cushy and warm place where they feed you when you get hungry and treat you nicely!" As Aru finished exclaiming her complaints, Haruka thought it was her time to shine, her time to be of assistance to Aru. As Kayoko tried to stop her, Haruka activated the detonator. The building was leveled, leaving the other members surprised while alerting the Abydos students. Though they can't seem to find Hoshino for some reason. As the rest of the Abydos students headed towards the location, they found PS68 who was responsible for the explosion. The Abydos students were especially angry considering how well they've been treating PS68. Thankfully, the ramen shop owner was safe. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem like PS68 will be safe from the FTC's wrath. While the two sides were fighting however, they were suddenly bombarded by mortal shells. It seems like the mortar shells originated from the Prefect Team. Although the Prefect Team was aiming for PS68, they don't seem that docile towards the Abydos students either. And it seems the Abydos students weren't so happy about the Prefect Team acting out operations in their academy area without their permission. Not too long after though, Chinatsu, one of the Prefect Team members, noticed Sensei being on Abydos's side. Realizing this, she knew this battle is a no-go, but the battle was inevitable, and all she could do was fight. Unfortunately, Chinatsu was right. They were fighting a losing battle from the beginning. As the Prefect Team was defeated, Ayane confronted the two Prefect Team members before being interrupted by Ako, who decided to answer Ayane's question on behalf of the Prefect Team. Meanwhile, Haruka had some ideas of her own.

As Haruka sneaked away from the area, Sensei locked eyes with her but decided to pretend they saw nothing. As for Ako, she decided to introduce herself as the Senior Administrator. Although she seemed nice, the Abydos students had a bad feeling about the current situation. Oddly enough, Ako seemed to blame Iori for her reckless actions inside another academy's district despite Iori saying she's only following orders. Ako continued to explain how the Prefect Team's only there to subdue certain individuals as part of the team's duties, but Ayane didn't agree in letting them be the on to take PS68 into custody since they're in Abydos's area, making the Abydos students the one who's responsible. Hearing Ayane's complaints about Gehenna's power abuse, Ako asked for Sensei's opinion on the matter. For Sensei, PS68 might be stupid, but they're not that stupid. Seeing the Abydos students disagreeing to hand PS68 over, Ako had no choice but to use brute force. As she said this however, some of the Prefect Team units were ambushed by Haruka, including Iori. Taken by surprise, Ako was then confronted by Kayoko telling her to cease her lies. Kayoko saw through Ako's facade. She knew that this whole operation was not the Head Prefect's style but rather a unilateral decision made by Ako. She even figured out that Ako never intended on taking PS68 into custody, but rather she wanted Sensei instead. Ako forgot that Kayoko was part of PS68, and since Kayoko saw through her lies, she had no choice but to bring out all her troops. It was the inevitable choice anyway since she's dealing with Schale, though she didn't actually intend for things to escalate. Seeing the overwhelming numbers, the Abydos students had no choice but to fight to protect Sensei. As the battle was about to begin however, it seems that PS68 wished for a temporary alliance with the Abydos students against the Prefect Team. And who wouldn't want some extra helping hands in a critical situation like this? Little by little, the Prefect Team troops were defeated, hurting Ako's confidence slightly, but she knew of Sensei's weakness and decided to bring out more infantry. She knew she had to be more careful as this would be uncharted territory and that if the Head Prefect were to find her, she'd be in trouble. Unfortunately for Ako, karma hit faster than the escalation of the situation as that's exactly what happened. Hina, the Head Prefect, made her appearance through a call asking what Ako was doing. Shocked by her appearance, Ako tried her best to lie about what she's doing. Unfortunately, Hina saw through her lies. And to add salt to the wound, Hina appeared to be in Abydos, the same place where the Prefect Team was carrying out the operation. As Ako tried to explain the situation, she noticed PS68 disappeared. Unable to explain the situation, Hina told Ako to cut all communications and reflect on her actions back in the Prefect Team club room. With the situation calmed down a bit, the Abydos students thought they had to fight Hina, but Ayane decided they made a negotiation first. Hina first mentioned the fact that the Prefect Team unauthorizedly deployed troops in another district and apologized for that matter, but she then brought up the fact that the Abydos students interfered with Prefect Team business. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Ayane wished Hoshino was there with the. Hearing the name Hoshino, Hina got curious. All of a sudden, Hoshino appeared. Seeing her, Hina got slightly nervous. Hina knew that Hoshino was no small problem, especially when knowing her after a certain incident happened. Hina then instructed the Prefect Team to retreat and formally apologized to the Abydos students, even going so far to bow down as a form of apology. Seeing her response, Iori asked about what they'll do with PS68, but Hina glared deathly at her. As quick as the Prefect Team appeared, the Prefect Team left after hearing Hina's orders. Before Hina left however, she had something to say to Sensei. It seems that Kaiser Corporation was planning something in the deserts of Abydos. She thought she needed to tell Sensei about it as she's not planning in informing Abydos. After that, Hina parted ways with Sensei. For PS68, things didn't seem too good for them as they had to move from their office. As they were packing up their stuff, Sensei made a surprise visit. Aru was scared since Sensei was on Abydos's side, but Sensei had no malicious intent as mentioned by Mutsuki. Despite trying her best to not embarrass herself, Sensei bid them farewell very nicely. Meanwhile, the Abydos students went to check in on the ramen shop owner. Thankfully, he's already recovered since "it was simply a scratch", said the owner. The students were concerned about his shop, but he said he's fine as he planned on closing the shop anyway due to already receiving an eviction notice. Hearing this, Ayane needed to make sure of something, so she told Sensei and Serika to head back to school first. When Sensei arrived at the main gate, they found Nonomi who came in early. She wanted to do some cleaning cause she couldn't just sit still. She then reminisced a bit about Sensei's arrival and all the events that had happened ever since. A bunch of problems were solved, yet new ones arose. As she talked for a bit longer, Shiroko arrived. She asked where Hoshino was and Nonomi replied with saying that Hoshino's somewhere inside the building. As Shiroko headed inside, both Nonomi and Sensei knew something was off with Shiroko, so they headed inside to figure it out. When they entered the building, they heard some noises and went to investigate. When they entered the room they heard the noise in, they saw Shiroko fighting against Hoshino. Nonomi then stopped Shiroko and told her to explain what's going on, but Shiroko refused, saying that this was between her and Hoshino only. Nonomi didn't take no as an answer though. As Shiroko was about to explain however, Hoshino diverted the topic and brought up the meeting they were supposed to have soon and left. When all the members were present, Ayane and Serika could feel the tension inside the meeting room, but the meeting proceeded anyway due to how urgent it was. Ayane then showed a property map of the school district. To their surprise, the majority of the district was currently owned by Kaiser Corporation, including the Shiba Seki Ramen Shop. The only areas not owned by Kaiser were the main building and parts of the areas surrounding it. Hearing this, Hoshino had a suspicion that the Abydos Student Council was responsible for this as only they had voting rights on the school assets. Looking back, Hoshino used to be part of the Student Council, but all her upperclassmen had resigned when she joined, leaving the new Student Council president and her, the vice president. Hoshino felt like a total idiot back then, but Shiroko encouraged her by stating how it was thanks to her that the Foreclosure Task Force was established, which actually ended up embarrassing her. Now that Hoshino thought about it, maybe the Student Council did work hard to pay off Abydos's debt. Unfortunately, they had to kept selling land at such low prices and were not able to keep up with the increasing interest, resulting in the district slowly becoming Kaiser property.

Seeing how much Kaiser was involved, Sensei decided to inform the Abydos students about what Hina said to them previously. According to Hina, Kaiser's planning something in Abydos's deserts. Hearing this, Serika thought of a brilliant plan, which is to just see for themselves what Kaiser's doing. Everyone supported the idea, and so they made preparations to head out to the Abydos Desert. Before they headed out, Shiroko had something to say to Sensei. Shiroko then handed Sensei something she found in Hoshino's bag. It was Hoshino's resignation letter. Although Sensei was curious about the letter, they wondered why Shiroko was looking through Hoshino's bag. Shiroko knew it was wrong, but she had to do it due to her suspicions. Sensei told her to keep it a secret for now as they have more important matters at hand. After a while, Sensei and the FTC arrived at the Abydos Desert by train while Ayane supported from the school building, but they could only get so far in with just the train. As they proceeded to walk through the desert, Ayane warned them about nearby dangers and told them to keep their guard up. Something still felt off for Hoshino though. Why would the Gehenna Prefect Team know so much about things surrounding the Abydos District that the Abydos students themselves were not aware of? The Head Prefect was incredible at collecting info, so she's bound to know something they didn't. Further down the desert, Hoshino felt familiar with the area. She used to go there for Student Council work. There used to even be an oasis nearby where the Abydos Desert Festival would usually be held, one so big it's bigger than most lakes and so deep you can go boating there. Well, before it dried up of course. The festival was so big that other schools would often visit. To think that decades had passed was unbelievable, but it's time to focus on the present. They still need to cover quite the distance to reach the sector Hina informed them about. After some more walking, Ayane picked up something massive. A huge town? A factory? A garrison? Whatever it is, it is huge. As they arrived at the location, they were suddenly greeted with gunfire. Not being able to avoid an encounter, they were forced to plow through the guards. The guards were not that strong, but they're definitely annoying. After a bit of looking, they found out that the location belongs to Kaiser PMC, another subsidiary of Kaiser Corporation. Suddenly, alarms began ringing. Tanks, armored vehicles, and even helicopters began appearing. They needed to escape as this was too much for them to handle all by themselves. Unfortunately, they were unable to escape due to the sheer amount of troops surrounding them. Ayane tried to warn them that someone's coming for them, but her connection was unstable. Soon enough, the person made their appearance. It was the Kaiser PMC Director, and he was not happy about the students barging in. It seemed like Hoshino and the Director knew each other. Since the other Abydos students were clueless, the Director introduced himself first as Abydos's creditor. Meanwhile, back in Gehenna, Ako was tasked to write 1000 pages worth of apology letters. Ako only used it as an expression, but she didn't expect Hina to actually tell her to write 1000 pages. Unfortunate for Ako. As she continued, she asked Hina about Hoshino as it seemed that Hina knew Hoshino pretty well. Although it was Hina's first time meeting Hoshino in person, she knew of her very well. Hoshino used to be super intelligent yet much more belligerent and violent, even considered a threat to Gehenna by Gehenna's Intelligence Committee. Had Ako and the Prefect Team fought Hoshino as she was then, Gehenna would've suffered great losses, especially with Schale there. Back to the Abydos students' current situation, they were accusing him for hiring the Helmet Gang and PS68 to take them down, but the Director claimed their accusations were simply spurious allegations and brought up the fact they broke into his property, attacked innocent employees, and destroyed facilities all to end up blaming him. He found this quite amusing, and since he was in a good mood, he decided to tell the students what Kaiser's doing in the Abydos Desert.

The Director explained how they were looking for some sort of treasure hidden somewhere beneath the Abydos Desert. "A treasure? That's impossible! Why would Kaiser prepare such massive amounts of troops for some treasure? Surely they're going to be used to take down Abydos." But the Director was telling the truth. Why would he waste such huge amounts of troops, vehicles, ammunition, and more just for five students? In fact, something much smaller was enough to deal with Abydos. All he needed was one phone call, and boom! Abydos's credit score was set to the minimum rating, increasing the variable interest rate by such a tremendous amount. Now they have to pay 90 million yen a month. Wait, there's more?!? The Director suddenly required them to deposit 300 million yen to Kaiser Loans by the week. There's no way the Abydos students would be able to pay it off, and the Director knew that, so he suggested that they just drop out and leave since the debt was never theirs to begin with. The Abydos students didn't want that, but Hoshino suggested that it'd be better that they just leave the area instead of futilely arguing with him. Back at Abydos, Hoshino had a short flashback to the past while the others were thinking about what they could do. They knew they had to do something. Shiroko suggested they finally go for drastic measures, but Hoshino denied the idea. Instead, she requested them to take a rest and think for a solution tomorrow. President's orders! One by one, the students left for home but Shiroko and Hoshino. Apparently, Sensei was still there too. Shiroko wanted to talk to Hoshino about something, but Hoshino felt super tired. So Shiroko left, signaling Sensei to talk about they-know-what through eye-contact. Hoshino was confused, so Sensei showed her her resignation letter. Knowing she couldn't hide anything anymore, Hoshino had no choice but to explain it, but she requested that she does so while taking a walk with Sensei, which they accepted. As they walked around the school, they noticed how dirty it was. Although Hoshino's memory was not what it used to be, looking back, the school was just a mess where nothing ever worked out and her upperclassmen were long gone. But then again, had she not joined the school, she wouldn't have met the other Abydos students. It was time for Hoshino to come close. She mentioned how she's been receiving offers from weird people for the past two years. Even recently, she received an offer that will instantly forgive half of Abydos's debt if she agreed to join the corporation this person's offering. She knew that if she accepted the offer, Abydos would fall for good, so she declined. The person's name was Black Suit. Though as suspicious as he looked, he didn't cause any trouble. About the resignation letter however, couldn't say Hoshino hadn't had any doubts. Hoshino knew she had to tell the other girls at some point, but she didn't want to bring up the past, especially since it wouldn't help them any good. She had no choice but to tell them the next morning. Before Hoshino and Sensei parted ways, Sensei told her something...The next morning, Ayane arrived at the school earlier than the others. As she arrived she noticed something. It was Hoshino's resignation letter, an academy dropout notice, and another letter. The letter mentioned about the offer Hoshino received, how half of Abydos's debt would be cleared if Hoshino dropped out, and Hoshino's final wishes, that Sensei would take care of Shiroko for her, and if they ever encounter each other again, they need not hesitate to destroy her halo. Seeing the message Hoshino left, the whole group was devastated. How could Hoshino just leave them like that? Well, rescuing Hoshino's more important. As they were planning how to however, gunshots were heard from a nearby area. Kaiser PMC was attacking the citizens nearby. With Hoshino dropped out, the Abydos Student Council, and the school itself, is no more. It didn't even take that long for the PMC to find them, so they needed to leave fast and prioritize evacuating Sensei. After going through numerous PMC soldiers, they reached the Director's location. The Abydos students claimed how the school building area was still Abydos property, and by Kaiser invading and destroying property, they're breaking the law which wouldn't be overlooked by the General Student Council. The Director found this funny as the GSC never helped them ever, and since Hoshino had dropped out, the Abydos Student Council was gone, reduced to atoms, consequently meaning that Abydos had been deemed unsustainable as an academy town, allowing Kaiser to assume control over the academy, being the district's owner. As this was ongoing, Hoshino was angered by Kaiser attacking Abydos. She thought the promise was that Abydos would be left alone if she dropped out, but that was not what's written on the contract. Black Suit followed the contract's agreement, which only said that Abydos's debt would be settled. In fact, he never promised Hoshino a lifelong contract with Kaiser PMC, oh no. He had something else in mind. He wanted to instead study and analyze Hoshino. Seeing where Hoshino ended up, she knew she messed up. And now, there's nothing she could do. Things were looking glum for Abydos. Their determination might be high, but their strength wasn't. And even if they won, what should they do? What COULD they do, Ayane asked. The reality check caused their morale to plummet, and they didn't know what to do. As they were thinking of giving up however, explosions were heard nearby. The soldiers were being attacked by a familiar group of people.

It was PS68! Abydos's current situation played with her heartstrings as it's similar to what Aru had experienced. Of course Aru wanted to help! Haruka and Mutsuki were also willing to help. Kayoko however joined only cause it's her group, but extra help is extra help. With the conjoined forces of the FTC and PS68, alongside Sensei's command, Kaiser PMC was defeated, causing them to temporarily retreat. As the girls returned, Sensei had other business to attend, involving a certain mysterious man. As Sensei arrived at a building somewhere in Kivotos, Black Suit greeted them oddly nicely. In fact, he had been waiting for their arrival. Black Suit knew a lot about Sensei and their arrival in Kivotos and wished for no conflict between him and them as they would be the largest obstacle to his plans.
